Job.JobDescription:
There’s never been a better time to join NJM!  With a nationally ranked reputation for outstanding customer service and a history that spans more than a century, NJM is a leading provider of worker’s compensation, automobile, and homeowner’s insurance in New Jersey. It is an exciting time to join NJM as we are expanding into other states.                                                                                                                                                   
Become a member of our team and you’ll be part of company who operates for the benefit of its policyholders and is committed to maintaining the highest levels of service.  Team members are offered a competitive compensation package and benefits including: a 401k plan, health coverage, a generous paid time off plan, and much more!  


NJM is currently seeking a Staff Auto Damage Appraiser , Senior to inspect first and third party vehicle damage and then providing an estimate to repair damage. The Appraiser is responsible for scheduling and writing estimates within Company guidelines at residences, shops or tow yards based on assignments received.


This role will be covering a Gloucester , Camden and part of Burlington county.


NJM does not provide a company vehicle but we do reimburse for mileage and tolls.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

  • Contacting and arranging schedules with customers, autobody shops and tow yards
  • Inspecting, photographing and appraising damage to vehicles involved in an automobile accident or loss.
  • Estimate parts and labor to repair damage, using standard automotive labor and parts-cost software.
  • Evaluate practicality of repair as opposed to payment of market value of vehicle before accident.
  • Review repair-cost estimates with automobile repair shop to secure agreement on cost of repairs.
  • Complete, review, and reconcile supplemental repair estimates
  • Estimates are created and negotiated based on company guidelines and applicable law.
  • Reinspect and review estimates for accuracy and conformity to Company guidelines.
  • Complete required courses and training

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • Customer service skills and experience
  • Multi-tasking, problem-solving, negotiation and decision-making abilities.
  • Technical aptitude, including working knowledge with estimating systems,
  • Own vehicle and have reliable transportation.
  • Adequate space for a home office and ability to work in an unsupervised environment.
  • 3-5 years of Body Shop experience and/or related insurance experience required.
  • High School Diploma or GED

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiar with CCC One Estimating platform
  • PA Auto Appraiser License
  • I-Car Certified

Today, NJM Insurance Group, is a leading mid-sized U.S. property and casualty insurance company with 90 consecutive years of A+ financial strength ratings by AM BEST. Due to exceptional employee experience, NJM has been included on the latest Forbes List of Best Employers in New Jersey for the fourth year in a row. The NJM reputation for being a top provider of outstanding customer service was reaffirmed by the most recent J.D. Power Auto Insurance Claims Survey.


Over the last five years, the Company has focused on a strategic plan that calls for it to become a regional property & casualty insurer and has transitioned away from its affinity-based membership model. To that end, the Company has added an independent agency model for new lines of middle and large commercial and has more than doubled its product offerings. NJM now offers its various products to businesses across New Jersey, Pennsylvania, New York, Maryland, Delaware, and Connecticut.


NJM’s Commercial Lines department conducts business for policyholders and preferred agencies within the Mid-Atlantic region, specifically NJ, PA, NY, MD, DE, CT. Products include Commercial Auto, G/L, Workers Comp, BOP, Excess/Umbrella, and Package. The Commercial Lines function encompasses Underwriting, Sales, Operations, Premium Audit, Product Management, Product Development, Loss Prevention and Business Process Unit.



NJM Insurance Group’s Claims Analytics group is seeking a Claims Insights Analyst. The Claims Insights Analyst applies a strong understanding of data sources and associated business processes to provide management with research, analysis and insights in support of departmental strategies and goals.


This position will perform analysis on large and diverse sets of data to tell compelling stories through presentations, dashboards and visualizations to drive strategic decision making. The Claims Insights Analyst is a highly motivated, creative self-thinker and has a good sense for interpreting and communicating the “why” behind the data and application to the business.


The Business Insights Analyst, Associate applies an understanding of data sources and associated business processes to provide management with research, analysis and insights in support of department strategies and goals. This position will run queries and perform basic analysis to assist in telling compelling stories through presentations, dashboards and visualizations to drive strategic decision-making. The Business Insights Analyst, Associate is a motivated, creative thinker and has a sense for interpreting and communicating the “why” behind the data and application to the business.  


Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.


  • Assist in the development of intelligent insights from analysis of both quantitative and qualitative data, testing basic hypotheses, running exploratory analysis and identifying trends in support of business strategies and goals. Assists in translating results/findings into clear and concise presentations for management and develop plans for corrective action. Assist in the development and enhancement of department KPI dashboards, analytics and reports to monitor performance to create a comprehensive view of the business.

  • Assist in collaborating with cross-functional business teams and Data Engineers to fully understand the meaning, business rules and structure of required data and ensure alignment and consistency of data to support the end-to-end journey. Partner with the department Business Process Unit to identify, plan and prioritize source system improvements that facilitate data analytics.

  • Assist in expanding understanding/knowledge of business processes and competitive environments. Scan the market to understand key trends impacting markets, customers, products, services and operational processes.

  • Assist in complying with Data Governance standards and guidelines for data definition, quality, accuracy, completeness, availability and security to encourage data integrity and conformance.

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • BS from a 4-year accredited college/university in related field (Statistics, Mathematics, Business Intelligence, Finance etc.) or equivalent experience.
  • Basic analytical aptitude with the ability to turn raw data into presentations containing insights and visualizations that are critical in making strategic business decisions.
  • Technical knowledge with the ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced work environment.
  • Ability to read and understand data models
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • 1+ years writing queries (T-SQL)
  • 1+ years using business intelligence tools (Power BI, SSRS, SAS, Excel)

Job.JobTitle: First Notice of Loss Associate - Hourly
Job.JobDescription:
The First Notice of Loss Associate serves as the first point of contact for policyholders, claimants or other parties reporting claims. They are responsible for addressing customer inquiries concerning the claim process and collecting essential details about the incident, to accurately and efficiently establish new Auto, Property and Commercial claims.  


Schedule (working 4 days per week): Monday-Friday (5:00PM - 9:00PM) and 2 Saturdays a month (8:30AM-4:30PM)


Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

  • Receive initial reports of loss or damage from policyholders, claimants or other parties.
  • Accurately process information into the system for assignment to an adjuster.
  • Address customers’ questions and concerns related to the claims process and procedures and offer clear instructions on the next steps.
  • Determine appropriate coverage and complete necessary follow-ups in a timely manner.
  • Navigate systems with proficiency to access appropriate information to service callers.
  • Perform additional duties within the department, as needed.

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to build rapport with customers and demonstrate empathy during what may be a stressful time
  • Excellent listening skills
  • Ability to navigate multiple programs simultaneously.
  • Accurate keyboarding and data entry skills
  • High School Diploma or GED

Starting Rate: $22

Part Time employees are eligible for Paid Sick Leave and PTO as well as state-mandated Leave policies.  Employees may also be eligible for a discretionary bonus.

General Summary 

 

Reporting to the General Claims Legal Operations Division Administrator, the Subpoena Unit Supervisor is responsible for the daily management, oversight, and delivery of subpoena and document production in the General Claims Legal Department. The Subpoena Unit Supervisor will ensure the timely and accurate review, analysis, processing, and response to subpoenas and other document production requests directed to the Company by supervising three subpoena clerks, analyzing document requests, and applying and improving processes. The Subpoena Unit Supervisor is responsible for maintaining compliance with legal and regulatory requirements, safeguarding highly confidential information, and fostering collaboration across business units to ensure efficient document retrieval and production.

This is a hybrid position with three days a week required in the office and up to two days a week working remotely. This is a Monday through Friday, day shift opportunity based in our West Trenton, New Jersey corporate office.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job. 

  • Provide direct supervision and daily workflow management for subpoena staff, ensuring appropriate workload distribution and timely completion of assignments. 
  • Establish and maintain quality control standards, performance metrics and compliance with subpoena response procedures and document production standards.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex subpoena, discovery, and litigation-related issues. 
  • Coordinate closely with General Claims Legal attorneys regarding legal and regulatory requirements. 
  • Develop employee skills related to document review, litigation, and subpoena compliance through coaching and training. 
  • Develop, recommend, and implement departmental objectives, workflow enhancements, and operational process improvements. 
  • Analyze and report on workload, productivity, operational performance, and trends to Legal Operations Division Administrator and General Claims Legal leadership to support operational decision making and resource planning.
  • Special projects, audits, and other departmental initiatives as needed. 

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

 

  • Paralegal Certificate required.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively lead, coach, develop staff. 
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to identify issues and implement effective solutions compliant with applicable Rules of Court and law. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail and customer service orientation. 
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities, multiple deadlines, and a high-volume workload. 
  • Demonstrated experience managing workflow, quality assurance processes, and performance metrics. 
  • Ability to interpret and apply legal, regulatory, and company policies related to subpoena responses and document production requests. 
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple departments. 
  • Associate’s degree.

Preferred Qualifications: 

 

  • Knowledge of subpoena response requirements, document retention practices, and legal document production processes. 
  • Minimum of 2-4 years of supervisory, leadership, or management experience, preferably in a legal, or insurance environment.

Small Business Sales Representative

General Summary: A brief description of the main purpose for this position.

For NJM Small Business in New Jersey, serves as a liaison and relationship manager between the company sales and underwriting departments, and our agency partners. Assess the strengths and weaknesses of agents and assist them in achieving a mutual goal of small business profitable growth in both volume and policy count. Ensures that agents are familiar with and use NJMs ProQuote platform, products, policies, procedures and services. Conducts agency training as required on our platform.  

Key Objectives


• Increased NJM Small Business submission flow, new business conversion, and written premium growth through disciplined agency engagement and execution
• Improved agent, and CSR clarity on appetite, workflows, and how to do small business with NJM.
• Strong connectivity between agencies and underwriting, resulting in fewer stalled opportunities, faster issue resolution, and improved partner experience.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

General Responsibilities

  • Promotes ease of doing business with NJM’s Small Business platform.
  • Demonstrates to Premier Agents our ProQuote platform and provides regular training sessions for our agents with small business capabilities in the field.  
  • Monitors agency small business results and follows up with agent as to small business growth.
  • Develop professional working relationships with agents, sales and underwriting teams. Conduct sales and information technology training for agents and their staff.
  • Keeps communication between agent and company continuously open and viable; and encourages agent usage of all NJM ProQuote systems.
  • Advise company of any industry information, new ideas, products or any changes in other carrier philosophies that could positively or adversely affect NJM Small Business.
  • Meet regularly with sales and underwriting to discuss agency results and opportunities for greater growth and profitability.


Specific Job Responsibilities

 

Daily Sales Activities 40%

  • Drive individual new submission flow into Small Business and manage local pipelines with New Jersey agent submitted small business.
  • Conduct regular in-person and virtual agent engagement with frontline producers and CSRs, including training, appetite refresh, workflow enablement, and quoting navigation
  • Create demand for NJM’s Small Business products by reinforcing appetite fit, speed-to-quote, and ease-of-doing-business advantages

 

Agency Engagement & Local Presence 20%

  • Establish credibility as a trusted advisor through NJM’s Small Business product knowledge, underwriting appetite clarity, and workflow guidance

Small Business Market and Competition Awareness 20%

  • Maintain awareness of local market dynamics, competitor activity, and agent feedback; share insights with sales and underwriting leadership.
  • Maintain active discipline across agency visits, training delivery, pipeline movement, and conversion actions

Agency and State Management 20%

  • Own and manage the assigned territory (New Jersey), taking accountability for production results, pipeline improvements, and execution discipline
  • Adjust focus across agencies and segments based on performance, opportunity, and strategic importance

 

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • College degree is a plus but not required.
  • Highschool diploma or GED required
  • 3+ years in commercial insurance distribution, agency management, or sales roles; Small Business experience preferred
  • Demonstrated success driving Agency Producer and CSR adoption, and improved conversion outcomes
  • Should be domiciled in New Jersey and willing to travel throughout NJM geographic footprint.
  • Must be results oriented with a track record in establishing, prioritizing and achieving business goals.
  • Demonstrate proficient communication, negotiation & presentation skills.
  • Must have good organizational skills, be self-motivated, and able to work independently, from a remote location.
  • Must be able to maximize technology to ensure high productivity
  • Ability to drive Small Business submission flow, placement behavior, and conversion through disciplined, local sales execution
  • Strong agency management capability, including prioritization and small business pipeline management.
  • Understanding of Small Business agency operations and the ability to influence Agency producer and CSR behavior through clarity and enablement
  • Working knowledge of Small Business underwriting appetite, products, and submission quality standards
  • Ability to build strong underwriting–agency connectivity and facilitate effective account-level collaboration
  • Must have valid driver’s license in good standing and have own vehicle for transportation. All business mileage and tolls will be fully reimbursable.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Nurse Case Manager, Medical & Managed Care (Workers Comp)
Job.JobDescription:
A Workers' Compensation Nurse Case Manager coordinates and manages the medical care of injured employees throughout the workers' compensation claim process.

Responsibilities include evaluating medical needs, assessing treatment progress, identifying barriers to recovery, educating stakeholders, and ensuring care is delivered in accordance with workers' compensation regulations and best practices. The official NJM job title is Medical Management Coordinator II/Telephonic Nurse Case Manager.

The position requires the nurse to work and communicate with other members of the Medical Management team in addition to the Workers' Compensation (WC) Claims team, WC Claims Supervisors, and other team members.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Demonstrate knowledge, skills, and competency in the application of case management standards of practice.
  • Develop and provide ongoing support of the rehabilitation plan through comprehensive assessment, planning, implementation, and overall evaluation of individual claimant needs. 
  • Facilitate the Injured Worker’s rehabilitation by coordinating medical treatment, advocate for the Injured Worker with all medical providers and stakeholders and educate the Injured Worker on their recovery process.
  • Understand, apply, and comply with all statutory, regulatory, licensing requirements, and NJM policies/guidelines that affect utilization review, case management, and medical management.
  • Attend on-site visits with Injured Worker, physicians and other treatment providers, when necessary.
  • Evaluate the appropriateness, medical need and efficiency of health care procedures and facilities according to established criteria or guidelines.
  • Effectively communicate and collaborate with management, peers, and colleagues to ensure alignment, compliance and effective management of assigned claims.
  • Participate and/or support identified project initiatives       
  • Proactively seek development opportunities and identify business process improvements to maximize effectiveness of operations and minimize cost.
     

Required Qualifications:

  • RN required
  • 5 years of clinical nursing experience required
  • WC/PIP experience preferred
  • Ability to travel within State of NJ/assigned territory dependent on business needs.
  • Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) is preferred.
  • Certified Case Manager (CCM) beneficial.
  • Strong internal and external relationship management skills
  • Detail oriented with exceptional time management and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment
  • Proactive
  • Willingness to learn and grow within the position
  • Demonstrate reliability and conform to the company’s attendance policy
  • Intermediate Microsoft Office Suite skills (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) with ability to navigate technology and multiple systems effortlessly. 
  • High School Diploma or GED Equivalent

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

As a Senior Quality Engineer, you'll be responsible for functional and automation testing of NJM’s business applications. This role is expected to actively leverage Generative AI and AI-assisted engineering tools to enhance test design, automation development, defect analysis, test data generation, and overall software quality delivery.


The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to effectively combine quality engineering expertise with AI-enabled productivity and automation capabilities.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:


  • Work in an agile, small team environment with a focus on speed and quality

Job.JobTitle: Identity and Access Management Engineer, Principal
Job.JobDescription:
The Identity and Access Management Engineer, Principal provides technical leadership across identity, authentication, authorization, privileged access, cloud security, governance, and automation, while supporting broader Azure and Microsoft 365 technologies. The position partners with cybersecurity, infrastructure, application, and architecture teams to deliver secure, resilient, and scalable enterprise solutions.


Responsibilities:

  • Architect, implement, administer, and support enterprise identity and access management solutions, including Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, and hybrid identity services.
  • Design and manage Entra ID capabilities, including Conditional Access, authentication methods, MFA, passwordless authentication, Identity Protection, Enterprise Applications, App Registrations, PIM, managed identities, and RBAC.
  • Design and support authentication, authorization, federation, SSO, and identity integrations using SAML, OAuth, OIDC, certificates, and modern authentication.
  • Manage secure integration of applications, service principals, workload identities, managed identities, and APIs with enterprise identity platforms.
  • Design and support privileged access, least-privilege, role-based access, and identity governance controls across cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Design and maintain secure identity and access controls across Azure subscriptions, resources, applications, and services.
  • Maintain working knowledge of AWS identity and access management platforms and their integration with enterprise identity services.
  • Architect, implement, administer, and support broader Azure, Microsoft 365, and hybrid-cloud solutions.
  • Engineer and support Microsoft 365 services, including Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Defender, and Purview.
  • Support Azure infrastructure and platform services, including compute, storage, networking, Private Link, Key Vault, monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery.
  • Implement cloud and identity automation using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Azure CLI, Terraform, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Develop and support cloud and identity monitoring, logging, alerting, and security telemetry integrations.
  • Provide senior-level troubleshooting and technical leadership for complex identity, Azure, Microsoft 365, and hybrid-cloud issues.
  • Develop technical standards, operating procedures, architecture documentation, and security controls.
  • Support audits, risk remediation, identity and cloud governance, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities:


  • Extensive hands-on experience designing, implementing, securing, and supporting enterprise identity and access management solutions.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory, including Conditional Access, MFA, passwordless authentication, PIM, RBAC, Identity Protection, federation, and hybrid identity.
  • Strong knowledge of authentication and authorization technologies, including SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, Kerberos, LDAP, PKI, and certificates.
  • Experience with Enterprise Applications, App Registrations, service principals, workload identities, managed identities, API permissions, and Microsoft Graph.
  • Strong understanding of identity governance, Zero Trust, least privilege, privileged access, and role-based access controls.
  • Extensive hands-on experience designing, implementing, securing, and supporting Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 environments.
  • Strong understanding of Azure architecture, networking, security, governance, monitoring, and resiliency.
  • Strong knowledge of Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Microsoft Defender, and Microsoft Purview.
  • Experience with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Azure CLI, Terraform, automation, and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience with cloud security concepts including encryption, secrets management, key management, privileged access, and security monitoring.
  • Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, diagnostic logging, and SIEM integrations.
  • Knowledge of AWS identity and access management concepts and platforms, including IAM, IAM Identity Center, roles, policies, permission sets, and identity federation.
  • Experience with enterprise infrastructure technologies including Windows Server, Linux, DNS, Active Directory, IIS, SQL Server, virtualization, and networking.
  • Strong communication, documentation, troubleshooting, and technical leadership skills.
  • Experience with Broadcom/CA IAM, ForgeRock, or similar IAM platforms is a plus.

Education and Experience:

  • 7–10 years of progressive experience in identity and access management, cloud engineering, Microsoft 365, cybersecurity, infrastructure, or related disciplines.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and supporting enterprise identity, Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure, Microsoft 365, and hybrid-cloud environments.
  • Experience leading identity modernization, cloud migrations, security implementations, or enterprise platform initiatives.
  • Relevant Microsoft identity, Azure, Microsoft 365, or security certifications are preferred.
  • AWS, Terraform, or other relevant industry certifications are a plus.
  • Technical leadership or mentoring experience is preferred; direct people-management experience is not required.

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Workday Integration Developer (Workday Studio, EIB, REST/SOAP, HCM & Finance)
Job.JobDescription:
Seeking a highly skilled Workday Integration Developer (official NJM job title) to design, develop, enhance, and support integrations between Workday and enterprise applications.


This role is responsible for delivering scalable, secure, and reliable integration solutions using Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, PECI, Workday Web Services (REST/SOAP), and Report-as-a-Service (RaaS). The ideal candidate possesses deep technical expertise within the Workday ecosystem, a strong understanding of Workday security and tenant management, and a proven track record of implementing enterprise-grade integrations in complex environments.


The successful candidate will partner closely with IT, vendors, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions while ensuring integration performance, data integrity, compliance, and operational stability. This role also serves as a subject matter expert, providing guidance on integration architecture, development standards, testing strategies, and Workday best practices.


Job Responsibilities:


Integration Design & Development

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and support Workday integrations utilizing:
    • Workday Studio
    • Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB)
    • Core Connectors
    • Cloud Connect
    • PECI
    • Workday Web Services (REST and SOAP APIs)
  • Develop inbound and outbound integrations between Workday and external systems, including payroll providers, benefits vendors, financial systems, and other enterprise applications.
  • Create and maintain XSLT transformations, XML schemas, and integration mappings to support complex business requirements.
  • Design scalable integration architectures that follow Workday and enterprise integration best practices.
  • Develop and maintain reusable integration components and standards to improve supportability and efficiency.

Workday Configuration & Security

  • Configure and maintain Integration System Users (ISUs), Integration System Security Groups (ISSGs), domain security policies, and related security configurations.
  • Build and maintain custom reports, calculated fields, and Report-as-a-Service (RaaS) solutions supporting integration and reporting requirements.
  • Partner with functional teams to align business process configurations, approvals, and event triggers with integration requirements.

Production Support & Operational Excellence

  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve integration issues across production and non-production environments.
  • Develop robust error handling, auditing, alerting, and recovery processes to ensure reliable operations.
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable solutions to recurring issues.
  • Support Workday tenant refreshes, migrations, and release activities, including impact assessments and regression testing.
  • Ensure integration solutions meet organizational standards for security, compliance, performance, and data governance.

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Collaborate with HCM, Finance, IT, and external vendors to define requirements and deliver effective integration solutions.
  • Participate in technical design reviews and provide recommendations for improving integration of architecture and operational processes.
  • Mentor junior team members and promote Workday integration development best practices.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, including design specifications, support procedures, configuration details, and data flow diagrams.
  • Stay current with Workday releases, emerging technologies, and integration capabilities to drive continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of Workday Integration development experience.
  • Advanced experience developing integrations using:
    • Workday Studio
    • EIB
    • Core Connectors
    • Workday Web Services (REST/SOAP)
       
  • Strong expertise with XSLT, XML, XPath, and integration design patterns.
  • Deep understanding of Workday HCM, Financial Management, and security architecture.
  • Experience configuring and supporting ISUs, ISSGs, and Workday security frameworks.
  • Experience building calculated fields, custom reports, and RaaS integrations.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience supporting Workday production environments and release management activities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Workday Pro Integrations Certification.
  • Experience with PECI, or other payroll-focused integrations.
  • Experience with Workday Orchestrate.
  • Experience integrating Workday with payroll providers, benefits vendors, financial systems, and other enterprise applications.
  • Familiarity with middleware and integration platforms.
  • Experience supporting Workday deployments.
  • Knowledge of enterprise security, compliance, and data privacy requirements related to HCM and Finance systems.

Key Competencies:

  • Workday Integration Architecture
  • Workday Studio Development
  • EIB and Core Connector Configuration
  • REST and SOAP API Development
  • XSLT/XML Transformation Design
  • Workday Security Administration
  • Report Writing and Calculated Fields
  • Troubleshooting and Root Cause Analysis
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Technical Documentation
  • Release and Tenant Management
  • Continuous Improvement and Best Practices

NJM's Facility Operations Team is seeking a Technology Leader (the official NJM title is Technology Leader, Facility Operations, Senior)  is responsible for the administration, support, integration, and continuous improvement of technology systems that support facility operations, building infrastructure, and maintenance management. This position serves as the primary technical resource for Facility Operations technology platforms, including Building Automation Systems (BAS), Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), access control systems, video surveillance systems, building network infrastructure, industrial communication protocols, and operational software environments.


The Technology Leader works closely with Facility Operations staff, Corporate Information Technology, Security, contractors, and vendors to ensure the reliability, security, and efficiency of facility technology systems. This role combines facility operations knowledge with information technology expertise to support mission-critical building systems and drive operational excellence.


This role does not have any direct reports.   This position is in the West Trenton office 5 days per week with occasional travel to the Hammonton and Parsippany Locations.


 Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.


Operations and Systems Support

·         Serve as the primary lead for Facility Operations technology systems and software platforms.

·         Manage system configurations, user accounts, permissions, and operational settings across supported applications.

·         Coordinate software updates, patches, upgrades, and system migrations with vendors and IT personnel.

·         Monitor facility performance metrics and identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.

·         Administer and maintain computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS), facility management software, and related platforms.

·         Manage FO SharePoint site to update information and provide development enhancements

·         Manage contracts for all software and support / licensing and renewals / negotiations / vendor management

·         Work with vendor management to represent FO on vendor management solutions.

·         Work with HR in support of Workday solutions and integrity of existing data and reporting.

Formal NJM Title: Commercial Lines Distribution Representative / Sr. Distribution Representative - Maryland / Delaware Territory

Department Name:  Commercial Lines Sales

Position Reports To:  Administrator, CL Sales
Job Location: Maryland market


General Summary: 

Do you have a strong network with property and casualty insurance brokers in the greater Maryland / Delaware area? Do you have prior experience in Commercial Lines Sales, Commercial Lines Production Underwriting, or as a Broker Relationship Manager in Commercial Lines? If so, this is the perfect opportunity for you! This position offers a generous base of $90,000 to $135,000 (commensurate with relevant experience) with a quarterly and annual incentive opportunity that has the potential to add a significant amount to your total compensation annually. You are also eligible for our incredible benefits package, which includes a 401k with a dollar for dollar match up to 8% with immediate vesting and an additional employer contribution after the first year that grows to an additional 6% over 15 years of service!

NJM Insurance Group, a leading mid-Atlantic property casualty carrier, seeks to expand distribution partner relationships, new business, and products in Maryland and Delaware. As part of that expansion, we are seeking an experienced Distribution Representative in Commercial Lines. This Distribution Representative will be based in the greater Maryland market (southern Delaware or Maryland strongly preferred), so that they can work closely with existing and new distribution partners to secure new business for the organization.


Distribution Representatives meet regularly with agency/brokerage distribution partners in pursuit of additional business in the small, mid and large-size markets. The right candidate would already possess key commercial agency/brokerage relationships, presence and credibility in the Maryland / Delaware territory. These relationships will specifically be utilized to appoint and grow our distribution partner network in the region consistent with NJM’s exclusive distribution model.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities: 

  • Match existing Maryland / Delaware agent relationships and books of business opportunities with those of NJM
  • Based on this analysis recommend for appointment new commercial lines distribution partners in the territory. Ultimately through the review process sign up all appropriate agents based on the strength of these current relationships
  • Pursue, upsell, cross-sell, recapture opportunities with agencies/brokers
  • Coordinate New Business Proposal Meetings on key accounts to agencies and brokers; present NJM optional plans
  • Key account pre-renewal discussion with agencies
  • Review competitor plans with NJM underwriting to ensure best pricing offered
  • Lead annual planning process. Implement and monitor throughout year
  • Review underwriting appetite and services with agencies and brokers
  • Attend POS (Point of Sale) when possible with agencies/brokers
  • Assist with contracting new agencies/brokers
  • Assist with onboarding and terminating agencies/brokers as required
  • Maintain agency/broker profiles
  • Attend corporate functions including Corporate Giving, Chamber of Commerce and Marketing events


Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:

  • Sales oriented with experience and successful track record selling standard commercial lines products in the noted territories
  • Ability to communicate orally and in writing with others to explain complex issues
  • Full knowledge of all commercial line’s standard insurance products and usages
  • Ability to manage multiple clients, tasks, and requests
  • Adequate knowledge of rating procedures, coverages, and industry operations to effectively manage, maintain, and write assigned client and prospect lists
  • Knowledge of insurance markets and reference to markets
  • Knowledge of insurance underwriting procedures
  • Results oriented with the ability to meet strategic goals as required for the assigned territory
  • Excellent analytical, problem resolution, negotiating and project management skills
  • Professional, committed, and self-motivated with the ability to focus on daily tasks
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office – Outlook, Word, Excel 


Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred (High School Diploma or GED required)
  • Minimum 5 years’ commercial insurance company experience in insurance industry, specifically in either Commercial Lines Marketing, Sales, Production Underwriting, Distribution and/or Relationship Management
  • Specific knowledge of the commercial lines in the Maryland / Delaware marketplace as it relates to new agent appointments and account opportunities


Required Certifications or Licenses: 

  • Must maintain and remain current with their producers’ state licenses and continuing education credits. If you do not currently have an active license, you will be expected to obtain one within a defined period of time.

The Enterprise Agile Transformation Coach supports the adoption, maturity, and sustainability of Agile ways of working across Property & Casualty insurance delivery teams. This role partners with business, technology, and operational leaders to improve delivery predictability, value flow, and outcomes across core insurance value streams, while ensuring alignment with regulatory, risk, and governance requirements. 


The Agile Coach acts as a change agent, guiding teams and leaders beyond mechanical Agile adoption toward a sustainable Agile mindset that balances speed, quality, and compliance in a regulated insurance environment. 


The official NJM job title is Agile Coach, Sr.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
 

Team & Role Coaching

  • Help teams and delivery leaders adopt an agile mindset through coaching
  • Coach multiple cross-functional delivery teams across key P&C domains (Policy, Billing, Claims, Data, Digital). 
  • Mentor Scrum Masters, Product Owners, Business Analysts, and delivery leaders to improve team maturity, flow, and outcomes. 
  • Reinforce clear role boundaries while promoting shared accountability. 
  • Observe, facilitate, and continuously improve Agile ceremonies with a focus on outcomes over process compliance. 
     

Insurance Value Streams & Delivery Flow

  • Coach teams organize work around P&C value streams rather than projects. 
  • Improve flow across intake, prioritization, delivery, and release. 
  • Align delivery metrics to meaningful insurance outcomes (cycle time, predictability, quality, customer experience). 
  • Support dependency management across policy, billing, claims, data, and vendor platforms. 
     

Organizational & Leadership Agility 

  • Partner with delivery leaders to model Agile leadership behaviors. 
  • Coach leaders on decision-making and flow-based planning. 
  • Support organizational change initiatives by reinforcing adoption and sustainability of Agile practices. 
  • Balance speed to market with governance, compliance, and risk needs. 
     

Agile Practices, Enablement & Community 

  • Support Scrum, Kanban, and hybrid delivery models. 
  • Support facilitates PI planning, quarterly planning, retrospectives, and workshops. 
  • Design and deliver Agile training, workshops, and role-based learning sessions for teams and key Agile roles and leaders.
  • Develop reusable training materials, coaching guides, and enablement content to support consistent Agile adoption across teams, roles, and value streams.
  • Support onboarding of new teams
  • Support the development and maturity of NJM’s Lean-Agile Center of Excellence.
  • Help define Agile coaching standards, playbooks, maturity models, and enablement plans.
  • Partner with leaders to scale consistent Agile practices across teams and value streams.
  • Facilitate Agile communities of practice and knowledge-sharing forums.
  • Track adoption progress and recommend continuous improvement actions based on team maturity, delivery metrics, and stakeholder feedback.

Required Qualifications:

  • SAFe Practice Consultant (SPC) certification required.
  • Bachelor’s degree and equivalent practical experience
  • 7+ years working in Agile or Lean delivery teams as a contributor
  • 3+ years as an Agile Coach, Scrum Master, or similar role
  • Experience supporting complex enterprise delivery teams
  • Strong facilitation, coaching, and communication skills
  • Ability to provide practical coaching experience in a real-world technology delivery environment with support from theoretical agile principles

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in Property & Casualty insurance or financial services
  • Exposure to core insurance platforms (Guidewire, Duck Creek, or equivalent)
  • Experience partnering with PMO or any governance groups. 
  • Agile certifications (ICP-ACC, ICP-ATF, CSM, CSP)
  • Experience with the following tools: Agile Place, Planview and JIRA
  • Prior hands-on software delivery or engineering experience is strongly preferred

Key Competencies:

  • Servant leadership and coaching mindset
  • Systems thinking
  • Change leadership
  • Collaboration across business and technology
  • Ability to balance agility with governance

Job.JobTitle: Staff Attorney - Insurance Coverage & Claims Counsel
Job.JobDescription:
The Staff Attorney I (official NJM job title) performs coverage analysis, drafts and reviews relevant communications, which may include reservation of rights letters and coverage position letters associated with claims under personal and commercial insurance policies. 


The Staff Attorney I also monitors outside insurance defense litigation, coverage litigation, and appellate work under the supervision of a more senior attorney.  The Staff Attorney I provides General Claims staff with legal advice regarding coverage and various claims questions, assists in responding to regulatory and consumer inquiries, and advises on legal developments in case law, statutes and regulations.  The Staff Attorney I also provides General Claims Legal perspective to NJM business units on various matters including fraud, policy language, marketing materials, and legislation.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provides in-house legal oversight, advice and strategy recommendations relating to insurance defense and coverage litigation in the trial and appellate courts.
  • Timely, accurately, and thoroughly analyzes legal issues and advises the General Claims department regarding complex personal and commercial auto, homeowners and commercial property and liability claims and coverage issues.
  • Drafts and reviews coverage position and reservation of rights letters and other correspondence.
  • Identifies legal issues and trends, analyzes industry impact and develops a strategy to respond.
  • Provides advice and legal insight from a claims perspective on policy language, corporate communications, fraud, marketing materials, legislation, and other issues with clear communication.
  • Prepares written responses to regulatory and consumer inquiries.

Required Qualifications:

  • B.A. or B.S. and J.D. from an accredited law school, NJ Bar Admission in good standing or Limited License for In-House Counsel pursuant to N.J.Ct.R. 1:27-2.
  • 1-5 years' experience providing legal advice regarding insurance coverage and insurance defense matters.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Decisive and well organized, ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Strong relationship-building skills and a commitment to customer service.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Admissions to practice in NY, PA, CT, MD or OH a plus.
  • Experience litigating insurance defense and insurance coverage cases.

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Workers' Compensation Adjuster, Claims, Claims Representative
Job.JobDescription:
NJM’s WC Claims Department is seeking an experienced Sr. Workers Compensation Claims Specialist who lives in or near Connecticut to provide on-site service to our policyholders and agents in that state.  This is a 100% remote position which includes virtual claims handling for customers in any area of CT and possibly MD, DE or PA as needed.  


At NJM, our WC Claims Department empowers our employees to focus on delivering guidance and empathy to our customers.  As a department driven by service and customer advocacy, we are committed to providing transparent, empathetic support and collaborative engagement during the life of a claim. The WC Claims Department takes pride in being a key component in the growth and success of our policyholders’ business operations.


To meet these expectations, WC Claims Specialists are supported by a dedicated call center who can field calls for them and other specialized units who are responsible for setting reserves, making permanency payments, and following through on subrogation so they can dedicate the time needed to manage claims. Many of our staff are long-tenured with a focus on building relationships, not only with our customers, but with each other providing a positive and nurturing work environment.

Hours: Monday to Friday 8:00AM- 4:15PM (Hours can vary depending on start time). Training may be required at one of our NJM offices.

Responsibilities:

  • Ensure quality management of claims in accordance with claims best practices and company guidelines, and timely, accurate documentation of claim activity

  • Provide a high level of customer service that promotes injured worker advocacy-based principles to improve outcomes for all parties 

  • Determine compensability and coverage issues by gathering medical and factual evidence

  • Administer the delivery of timely, appropriate, and accurate benefits

  • Evaluate the claim for potential fraud indicators and escalate the claim to SIU, as appropriate

  • Recognize and investigate subrogation opportunity and refer to NJM subrogation staff for recovery of third-party funds

  • Initiate and provide excellent communication with all stakeholders (injured workers, medical providers, attorneys, policyholders, agents, etc.) professionally and proactively with a customer-centric approach

  • Apply critical thinking skills to evaluate and mitigate exposures, and establish and implement a proactive strategic plan of action

  • Assign and refer claim petitions to Counsel, and work to resolve the claim within given authority

  • Build rapport with policyholders and agents, conduct on-site investigations when necessary, and educate policyholders and agents on NJM procedures, policies, and claim practices

  • Prepare and attend Claim Reviews at policyholder or agent locations in CT or virtually for further locations.

  • Serve as a liaison between policyholders/agents and various departments in NJM.

  • Represent WC Claim in on-site capabilities meetings to onboard new policyholders in CT. 

  • Participate in training programs to keep current on relevant issues/topics

  • Recommend process improvement where applicable to best improve the department efficiency, work product, and service commitment to interested parties

  • Demonstrate a commitment to NJM’s Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, and apply knowledge of compliance policies and procedures, standards, and laws applicable to job responsibilities in the performance of work

Required Qualifications and Experience:

  • 5+ years’ experience as a Workers' Comp Claim Representative, or comparable knowledge and experience with various aspects of claims handling and/or process including advanced knowledge of medical terminology and WC regulations for CT claims.

  • Knowledge of and/or experience working with liens and Medicare Set-Asides to secure full and final settlements

  • Customer service oriented with strong written and oral communication skills

  • Strong interpersonal skills with ability to work both in a team and independently

  • Demonstrated organizational skills, and use of sound decision-making capabilities

  • Working knowledge utilizing an automated claim processing system and Microsoft Office tools including Word and Outlook

  • Licensed in CT to adjust WC claims.

  • Ability to travel for business purposes, approximately 2 – 3 days a week meeting with policyholders and/or agents

Preferred:

  • Associate or bachelor’s degree

  • AIC/CPCU or other applicable insurance designations

  • Experience using Guidewire Claim Center, OnBase and additional Microsoft Office tools including Teams, Excel and PowerPoint

  • Knowledge and experience in WC claims handling in various states including PA, MD and/or DE.

  • Licensed in other states including DE to adjust WC claims.

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Overview

The Workstation Support Intern will assist the IT team in providing technical support for workstation hardware, software, operating systems, and network connectivity issues. This role offers hands-on experience troubleshooting technology problems, supporting IT projects and documenting procedures while developing practical enterprise IT support skills.

Job Responsibilities

  • Respond directly to technical questions or issues, or refer them to the appropriate employee or group in a timely manner. Utilize in-house and Internet resources when researching solutions for job related issues. Keep current in technology and continuously expand knowledge through training and review of industry literature.
  • Assist the Senior Workstation Specialists during large-scale projects related to workstation hardware, applications, and/or workstation OS upgrades. Work in coordination with the IT Service Desk in the Field Analyst capacity when assigned.

Work Orders, RFC's, Incident and Problem tickets need to be completely documented so that Management and co-workers gain a complete picture of what transpired by reading the tickets. Descriptions of problems and resolutions to the problems are completely documented so the knowledge can be reused by co-workers. Status information is recorded promptly on Work Orders and Assigned tickets so that accurate, complete status is always available by reading the assigned Ticket. Status indicators, all dates and other fields (e.g. impact, priority) on tickets are accurately and completely valued.

  • General knowledge and experience with Microsoft SCCM

  • General knowledge of active directory and group policy
  • Experience with Dell Optiplex desktop line
  • Experience with IBM/Lenovo hardware line
  • Cumulative GPA 3.0 or greater
  • Commutable to our West Trenton, New Jersey office

Overview

The SIU Analyst Intern will support NJM's Special Investigations Unit by using data analytics, research, and reporting to help identify potential insurance fraud and support investigative teams. The Commercial Claims Supervisor is responsible for leading a team of Commercial Line adjusters and successfully interact with our internal and external business partners.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

  • The position requires excellent communication and time management skills as well as a strong organizational background. This individual must be a creative & proactive problem solver, analytical and an independent contributor who can also work as a member of the team. Job.CustomJobTypeName: Workers' Compensation Adjuster, Claims, Claims Representative
Job.JobDescription:
NJM’s WC Claims Department is seeking an experienced Claims Specialist, Sr. who lives in Western or Central PA to provide on-site service to our policyholders and agents in that area.  This is a 100% remote position which includes virtual claims handling for customers in any area of PA and possibly MD, DE or CT as needed.  

At NJM, our WC Claims Department empowers our employees to focus on delivering guidance and empathy to our customers.  As a department driven by service and customer advocacy, we are committed to providing transparent, empathetic support and collaborative engagement during the life of a claim. The WC Claims Department takes pride in being a key component in the growth and success of our policyholders’ business operations.

To meet these expectations, WC Claims Specialists are supported by a dedicated call center who can field calls for them and other specialized units who are responsible for setting reserves, making permanency payments, and following through on subrogation so they can dedicate the time needed to manage claims. Many of our staff are long-tenured with a focus on building relationships, not only with our customers, but with each other providing a positive and nurturing work environment.

Hours:

Monday to Friday 8:00AM- 4:15PM (Hours can vary depending on start time).

Training is required at the NJM- West Trenton office.

Responsibilities:

  • Ensure quality management of claims in accordance with claims best practices and company guidelines, and timely, accurate documentation of claim activity

  • Provide a high level of customer service that promotes injured worker advocacy-based principles to improve outcomes for all parties 

  • Determine compensability and coverage issues by gathering medical and factual evidence

  • Administer the delivery of timely, appropriate, and accurate benefits

  • Evaluate the claim for potential fraud indicators and escalate the claim to SIU, as appropriate

  • Recognize and investigate subrogation opportunity and refer to NJM subrogation staff for recovery of third-party funds

  • Initiate and provide excellent communication with all stakeholders (injured workers, medical providers, attorneys, policyholders, agents, etc.) professionally and proactively with a customer-centric approach

  • Apply critical thinking skills to evaluate and mitigate exposures, and establish and implement a proactive strategic plan of action

  • Assign and refer claim petitions to Counsel, and work to resolve the claim within given authority

  • Build rapport with policyholders and agents, conduct on-site investigations when necessary, and educate policyholders and agents on NJM procedures, policies, and claim practices

  • Prepare and attend Claim Reviews at policyholder or agent locations in Western and/or Central PA or virtually for further locations.

  • Serve as a liaison between policyholders/agents and various departments in NJM.

  • Represent WC Claim in on-site capabilities meetings to onboard new policyholders in Western and/or Central PA. 

  • Participate in training programs to keep current on relevant issues/topics

  • Recommend process improvement where applicable to best improve the department efficiency, work product, and service commitment to interested parties

  • Demonstrate a commitment to NJM’s Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, and apply knowledge of compliance policies and procedures, standards, and laws applicable to job responsibilities in the performance of work

Required Qualifications and Experience:

  • 5+ years’ experience as a Workers' Comp Claim Representative, or comparable knowledge and experience with various aspects of claims handling and/or process including advanced knowledge of medical terminology and WC regulations for PA, MD and/or DE claims.

At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as an Senior Underwriter, AIG Risk Management (AIGRM) to play your part in that transformation. It’s an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.


Make you mark in Underwriting


AIG underwriting teams help to find insurance solutions in areas including Financial Lines, Property, Casualty, Specialty Lines, Cyber, Multinational Clients, and High Net Worth individuals. We are reimagining how we help customers to manage risk, transforming our operating model, and reshaping our role responsibilities and career pathways. The goal is to unlock the full potential in each colleague – empowering our people to grow as insurance professionals and add more value to our customers and AIG.


How you will create an impact


The Senior Underwriter will be responsible for underwriting the Workers’ Compensation, General Liability and Auto Liability primary Casualty product lines and typically manages accounts/clients that are most complex.


  • Develops and manages underwriting strategies for both renewals and prospects within his/her portfolio of accounts. This includes knowledge of the current market penetration of AIGRM products and the development of specific plans to increase portfolio share. 
  • Develops and implements negotiation strategies. Makes independent sales calls to market and cross-market products. Identifies target markets, designs, and implements strategies for lead development and builds prospect lists.
  • Provides technical direction to management, less senior specialists, producers, and claims adjusting personnel. Communicate risk appetite and AIGRM Value Proposition to brokers. 
  • Collaborate with Distribution, Territory Managers, and other line(s) of business underwriters to target desirable accounts and cross selling opportunities from brokers.
  • Rapidly evaluate, prioritize, and select submissions to be underwritten.
  • Recognize and create cross sell opportunities for other Commercial products.
  • Collaborate with broker to understand the deal structure, terms, and AIG Services that best meets clients’ needs. 
  • May review, evaluate and make recommendations to underwriting guidelines. 
  • May direct or conduct internal underwriting audits. 
  • Negotiate pricing, terms & conditions, and deal structure with brokers and clients.
  • Participate in special underwriting projects as needed. 

What you’ll need to succeed


  • 5+ years of Commercial Insurance Company, Agency, or Brokerage experience. 
  • Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university. 
  • Proven ability to build and maintain strong professional relationships.
  • Advanced working knowledge of US Casualty lines of business (Workers’ Compensation, Auto Liability, and General Liability) including product features, forms, regulatory environments, and risks etc. 
  • Demonstrated sales, marketing, and relationship building experience. 
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills. 
  • Highly motivated and results oriented. 
  • Ability to work in dynamic, rapidly changing environment, adapting to changing requirements and collaborating with a wide range of colleagues to quickly deliver solutions.
  • Expert with underwriting analytical tools and technology.

The ideal candidate for this role in AIG’s Data, Digital and Cyber Legal Group will be a strategy-oriented attorney who embraces a dynamic advisory practice. You will craft legal solutions that protect AIG from the complex risks presented by cutting-edge artificial intelligence, data, digital and technology issues, while simultaneously moving AIG’s business forward. You will translate rapidly evolving legal and regulatory requirements into practical, risk-based advice and help AIG evaluate and responsibly deploy AI and other innovative and emerging technologies while managing legal, regulatory, contractual and reputational risk.

In this role, you will support AIG’s global businesses and corporate functions by:

  • Advising on legal and regulatory issues involving data and information governance, data analytics, digitization, and the use of AI and other emerging technologies in the context of insurance and financial services;
  • Advising AIG businesses and corporate functions on proposed and existing AI use cases, including generative AI, machine learning, and automated decision systems;
  • Identifying applicable legal and regulatory requirements; assessing risk based on the use case, data, users and potential impact; and recommending proportionate controls, conditions, escalation paths and documentation;
  • Supporting the design, implementation and continuing evolution of AIG’s enterprise AI governance framework, including intake and review processes, risk classification, approval, and exception procedures, inventories, accountability, documentation, human oversight, testing, monitoring, change management and lifecycle controls;
  • Developing and maintaining AI- and technology-related policies, standards, playbooks, contract positions, guidance and training;
  • Monitoring and analyzing emerging AI laws, regulations, supervisory guidance, enforcement activity, litigation, standards, and industry practices across relevant jurisdictions; advising on their impact; and translating developments into clear recommendations for AIG, including updates to policies, governance processes, controls, training, and business practices;
  • Drafting, reviewing and negotiating agreements for third-party AI tools and other technology services, including provisions addressing data use and model training, confidentiality, privacy, cybersecurity, intellectual property and output rights, transparency, audit and testing rights, regulatory cooperation, performance, indemnification, liability, termination and transition support;
  • Supporting regulatory inquiries, examinations, disclosures, and other engagements relating to AI, data, digital, and technology matters;
  • Partnering with technology, operations, business, legal, compliance, risk, procurement and regulatory colleagues globally to support AIG’s AI, data, digital, and technology initiatives; and
  • Serving as a thought leader on specialized legal and regulatory topics for internal and external stakeholders, including industry groups.

The successful candidate will:

  • Have 6+ years of experience as an attorney with at least two years of experience advising clients in AI legal matters;
  • Have a J.D. degree from an accredited U.S. law school and be licensed to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction;
  • Have significant experience at a law firm, in-house legal department, regulator or a combination of these settings advising clients and business partners on AI, data, digital, and technology initiatives, preferably in the context of insurance and/or financial services;
  • Have experience advising on AI, data, digital, and technology transformation or related regulatory matters, evaluating complex or novel initiatives, and translating legal requirements into practical, risk-based controls and business guidance;
  • Have experience drafting, reviewing and negotiating technology, data and/or AI-related commercial agreements;
  • Have excellent legal analysis, drafting, communication and project-management skills, including the ability to explain technical and regulatory concepts clearly to legal, technical, business, and executive audiences;
  • Be collaborative, nimble, responsive, and customer-focused;
  • Take ownership of significant matters, exercise sound judgment in a fast-moving environment, and contribute to the Global Legal, Compliance and Regulatory Department’s collaborative culture and reputation as a practical business partner;
  • Have experience in insurance, financial services or another highly regulated industry; and
  • Preferably hold an AIGP, CIPP/US or comparable privacy, AI governance or technology certification.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Workers' Compensation Adjuster, Claims, Claims Representative
Job.JobDescription:
Join us as a Complex Claims Director/Examiner to grow your career at the forefront of Federal Workers Compensation insurance.


Make your mark in Claims

Our Claims teams are the proven problem solvers of choice for clients, delivering consistent technical excellence and showcasing our service differentiation to create an unparalleled global claims handling experience. Through a robust stakeholder feedback loop and supported by consistent processes and leadership, we take pride in delivering responsive, fair and professional service with empathy and efficiency.


How you will create an impact

  • Focused on Workers Compensation within the Federal jurisdiction, this role is an ideal opportunity to develop your expertise in handling and investigating Defense Base Act claims. The aim is deal with claims through a proactive, best practice approach, in line with AIGs quality standards.
  • Utilize investigation, claim handling, litigation, and negotiation skills to ensure timely cost- effective claim settlements and protect recovery rights when applicable.
  • Provide prompt effective customer service to differentiate AIG from our competitors
  • Your work will involve regular contact with internal stakeholders and brokers, (medical) experts, clients’ lawyers, injured workers or their legal representatives. We want you to build effective relationships with internal and external customers, while acting as a point of referral.  
  • You will also proactively identify and review suspect/fraudulent claims on a consistent basis – dealing with such claims in line with our clear guidelines. 
  • Claims could be of unlimited value but utilize independent decision making with reserve and settlement authority up to $500,000. 
  • Provide mentoring and technical guidance to Claim Representatives
  • In addition, you can use the claims experience you gain to help improve our products in collaboration with colleagues in underwriting.
     

What you’ll need to succeed 

  • Knowledge of legal / regulatory and litigation / procedural requirements for Federal Workers Compensation claims.
  • Specialist knowledge of Defense Base Act claims is preferred.  
  • Proven experience in settlement evaluation and negotiation.
  • Policy language skills enabling accurate and consistent policy wording interpretation.  
  • Lateral thinking and the ability to problem solve and develop new ideas to improve working practices. 
  • Strong communication, time management, administrative and report-writing skills. 

Ready to step up to new challenges? We look forward to reviewing your application. Veterans encouraged to apply.

Job.JobDescription:
At AIG, we protect our clients against uncertainty and risk and provide the confidence for tomorrow’s opportunities. Join us as a director of a Workers Compensation claims team to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.


Make your mark in Federal Workers Compensation Claims

Our Claims teams are the proven problem solvers of choice for clients, delivering consistent technical excellence and showcasing our service differentiation to create an unparalleled global claims handling experience. Through a robust stakeholder feedback loop and supported by consistent processes and leadership, we take pride in delivering responsive, fair and professional service with empathy and efficiency.


How you will create an impact

  • This position is responsible for leading a team of Claims Examiners on the Federal WC Claims team and for directing activities consistent with the mission statement of AIG Claims, Inc. by achieving stated goals through best practices and other acceptable means.
  • Provides leadership that encourages and supports a professional environment and promotes a business culture that leverages attainment of desired business results.
  • Ensures understanding and administration of claim policies, procedures, and practices in accordance with company and policy standards.
  • Implements procedures that will shape behaviors to achieve quality results on a consistent basis in meeting Best Claim Practices to benefit of customers and business partners.
  • Evaluates and measures operational compliance in concert with Claim Handling Guidelines in meeting team goals.  
  • Ensures appropriate claim file reserving, claim payments, legal/allocated expenses and recoveries are effectively applied and consistent with company guidelines via review and management of Open and Closed file reviews as well as other review processes. 
  • Ensures that high quality Claim Summary Reports are being effectively completed and managed by assigned team to promote customer service excellence.  
  • Directly responsible for implementing a people strategy that supports training and skills improvement initiatives that achieve increased bench strength and improved career pathing for assigned team. 
  • Directs and leads team in achieving business strategies and plans in support of agreed upon objectives. 
  • Performs other duties as assigned by office AVP and/or WC Sr. Leadership  
     

What you will need to succeed

  • Proven claims adjusting experience and extensive leadership experience within a claim technical operation, in-depth understanding of Workers’ Compensation claim handling and servicing requirements. 
  • Specialist knowledge of Defense Base Act claims is preferred.  
  • Leadership skills in direction setting, change management, customer focus and talent development
  • Analytical skills with strong business acumen and ability to work across organization in matrix reporting relationships
  • Strong (oral / written) communication and interpersonal skills
  • Technical expertise in one or more claim functions
  • Career development, mentoring and coaching skills
     

Ready to win together? We would love to hear from you.


For positions based in Jersey City, the base salary range is $99,000 - $143,000.  For positions based in New York, the base salary range is $105,000 - $148,000.  For positions based in Chicago, the base salary is $120,000 - $150,000.  For positions based in Boston, the base salary range is $122,000 – $150,000.  Compensation for this position includes base salary and eligibility for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable incentive plan. Your actual compensation will be dependent on your skills, experience, and qualifications. If your compensation expectations are above the posted range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us.  In addition, we’re proud to offer a range of competitive benefits, a summary of which can be viewed here: US Benefits Overview.


At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office.  This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.

Job.JobTitle: War Hazard Recovery Claims Examiner - Federal Workers Compensation
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Workers' Compensation Adjuster, Claims, Claims Representative
Job.JobDescription:
Join us as a War Hazard Claims Examiner to grow your career at the forefront of Federal Workers Compensation insurance.

Make your mark in Claims

Our Claims teams are the proven problem solvers of choice for clients, delivering consistent technical excellence and showcasing our service differentiation to create an unparalleled global claims handling experience. Through a robust stakeholder feedback loop and supported by consistent processes and leadership, we take pride in delivering responsive, fair, and professional service with empathy and efficiency.

How you will create an impact 

  • Review, investigate, and manage War Hazards Compensation Act (WHCA) claims in compliance with federal regulations, contractual obligations, and company policies.
  • Evaluate claim documentation, including medical records, employment records, incident reports, and insurance policies, to determine eligibility for recovery under the War Hazards Compensation Act and pursue reimbursement opportunities when appropriate.
  • Partner with employers, legal counsel, government agencies, vendors, and medical providers to obtain necessary documentation, address claim discrepancies, and support timely claim resolution.
  • Verify the accuracy of benefit calculations, reimbursement amounts, and recoverable expenses to ensure appropriate claim outcomes.
  • Maintain detailed and organized claim files, documenting investigations, decisions, supporting evidence, and claim activity throughout the lifecycle of the claim.
  • Ensure all claim information meets AIG standards for data quality, accuracy, and integrity.
  • Identify claim trends, emerging patterns, and opportunities for process improvement to enhance operational efficiency and drive positive business results.

What you’ll need to succeed 

  • Strong claims investigation, research, and analytical skills.
  • Experience with recovery and reimbursement processes is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of workers' compensation claims, including applicable legal, regulatory, litigation, and procedural requirements.
  • Familiarity with the Defense Base Act (DBA) is preferred but not required.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Proven case management, time management and organizational skills.
  • Critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify issues, evaluate options, and implement practical solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Innovative and forward-thinking mindset, with a passion for identifying opportunities to improve processes and enhance operational effectiveness.
  • Proficiency in claims management platforms and Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.
  • Ability to support business objectives through timely completion of weekly, monthly, ad hoc reporting, and special project assignments.
  • Self-motivated team player who can work independently while contributing to a collaborative and results-driven environment.

Ready to step up to new challenges? We would love to hear from you.
