This position operates in an office environment and requires frequent use of a computer, telephone, and other standard office equipment. This description is a general statement of essential job functions and responsibilities. The position may include other duties as assigned.

The purpose of the AWS Cloud Engineer IV is to design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure systems using Amazon Web Services (AWS). This position will play a crucial role in ensuring the scalability, security, and robustness of our cloud solutions. The role will have extensive experience with the AWS platform and its cloud service offerings, as well as a deep understanding of cloud architecture and design principles. The AWS Cloud Engineer IV will collaborate closely with various teams, including development, operations, and security, to create and implement automation processes and standards for AWS cloud services. This position will ensure that all infrastructure components meet performance and security standards, conduct systems tests, develop and maintain design and troubleshooting documentation. This role will participate in the creation of new policies and procedures for cloud service use and compliance. The AWS Cloud Engineer IV will provide technical support for the AWS platform, working to improve capabilities and ensure the optimal operability of the AWS infrastructure.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Performs the role of Lead Engineer/Architect.

  • Designs and develops cloud-based solutions in AWS that are scalable, highly available, fault tolerant and easily maintainable.

  • Guides and provides technical guidance to platform and application development teams.

  • Ensures all AWS cloud infrastructure components meet proper performance and security standards.

  • Partners with software engineers and conducts code reviews.

  • Participates in the creation of new policies and procedures for cloud service use and compliance.

  • Provides advice on migrating existing products into an AWS environment.

  • Seeks continuous learning and stays up-to-date with the latest AWS technologies and best practices to drive innovation and efficiency within the organization.

Leads and facilitates all technical aspects of several projects.

  • Collaborates and supports the design and development of Enterprise applications and integrations.

  • Champions and applies best practices, including design reviews and continuous integration/deployment.

  • Works to minimize, if not eliminate, defects upon delivery.

  • Partners with IT staff to perform a variety of complicated tasks with a wide degree of creativity and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.

  • Collaborates and actively participates in all phases of the Agile product lifecycle, including design, development, and deployment.

  • Monitors AWS What’s New and other forums to identify either changes to services or announcements of new services to determine fit for ICW infrastructure.

Partners with project management and other engineering teams in determining overall system solutions.

  • Works collaboratively as a key contributor to a high performing team to improve and grow the AWS platform using best practices and technologies.

  • Regularly evaluates existing cloud infrastructure to identify risks or opportunities for improvement.

  • Provides expertise and shares knowledge and contributions to application development on multiple large-scale, business critical systems.

  • Writes quality system functional specifications.

  • Engages and partners with application teams to clearly understand the system design and roadmap.

  • Actively collaborates with the application Teams to conceptualize, design, and implement application and system architecture.

  • Works with security team to conceptualize, design, and implement application and security architecture.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

 This position does not have supervisor responsibilities but may mentor and train other software engineers.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree from four-year college or university required with a major in Computer Science, Information Technology or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

AWS Solutions Architect Associate, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer and/or AWS SysOps Admin Certification required.

  • Experience with creating designs for AWS/Cloud applications and networks.

  • Experience with AWS Services including Lambda, EC2, ECS, S3, CDK, Cloud Formation, EventBridge, Secrets Manager, DynamoDB, SNS, SQS, Step Functions, CloudTrail and CloudWatch.

  • Experience in supporting highly available applications.

  • Ability to think critically and create solutions for unique scenarios.

PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The purpose of the Senior Managing Litigation Attorney is to oversee a team of attorneys ranging from entry level to seasoned senior litigation management attorneys.  This position is responsible for overseeing and reviewing work performed by attorneys to ensure compliance with defense counsel guidelines.  The role works to improve processes, as well as assists with budget planning, financial measures and results. The Senior Managing Attorney will identify and lead initiatives to improve the team’s efficiency and ensures effective communication between the legal and business teams.  This role acts as both a Litigation Attorney with a reduced case count and manages a staff of Litigation attorneys. The position works autonomously and under the general supervision of the Litigation Management’s department Director.

This is a hybrid position, offering the flexibility to work from both home and the office. Candidates must be able to work from one of our California branch offices in San Diego, Pasadena, or Rancho Cordova.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Directs the operations of law office personnel providing litigation and legal services.

  • Oversees the law office activities to ensure efficient operations of In-House Counsel.

  • Determines the intake and assignment of cases to ensure distribution based on each attorney’s level of expertise and associated location (region or county).  

  • Achieves the departments and company goals by making strategic business decisions.

  • Ensures the firm is achieving its client satisfaction goals by evaluating productivity and quality of service. 

  • Identifies, makes recommendations for work process improvements and follows through to implement remediations. 

  • Works with leadership to ensure the department meets financial and ROI goals, identifies trends, prepares reports, and implements modifications as needed.

  • Mentors less experienced attorneys and ensures the team continues to expand their job-related knowledge, skills and abilities.

  • Regularly reviews cases and provides feedback on legal strategies, compliance with deadlines, timeliness on response, and maximizing the department’s core goals.

Provides litigation services and is responsible for all aspects of assigned Workers’ Compensation matters.

  • Handles a reduced caseload of litigated files and ensures files are fully worked and moved to resolution.

  • Litigates workers’ compensation cases in California before all state and federal courts, administrative boards, and other court proceedings.

  • Represents ICW Group, its related entities and insureds before administrative boards, state and federal courts, Court of Appeal, and the California Supreme Court.

  • Analyzes complex legal and factual issues; conducts extensive, well-reasoned legal research, as necessary; independently develops and presents defense strategies on behalf of ICW Group.

  • Provides strategic legal advice, recommendation, and implementation of clear, cost-effective, and efficient plans of action.

  • Assists in analyzing, reviewing, and distributing information on new legislation, regulations, and court decisions.

Provides oversight of a team of Litigation Management professionals.

  • Oversees the entire employee lifecycle from identifying, training, coaching and retaining talent.

  • Supervises and evaluates, mentors, motivates, and develops attorneys to strengthen the legal team.

  • Communicates clear performance expectations for the assigned team as well as providing support and guidance for achieving the department’s metric, billable hours and expectations.

  • Communicates and enforces team values including mission statement of In-House Counsel (IHC) and ICW.

  • Establishes and maintains the overall work cadence and, in partnership with Department leadership, ensures performance and outcomes strive for excellence in delivery and customer experience.

  • Acts as a resource for team members to answer questions and assist in the solution to complex problems.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

Directly supervises employees within the Litigation Management team and carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with company policies and applicable laws. These responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; conducting performance and salary reviews; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems; coaching, mentoring, and developing team members to further their skills and knowledge; creating and monitoring development plans; setting performance expectations/goals; forecasting staffing needs and planning for peak times and absences; enforcing department policies and procedures.

  • Bachelor’s degree from four-year college or university required.  Juris Doctorate from an accredited law school required. 

  • Minimum 10 years’ workers’ compensation legal experience handling complex cases along with a minimum of 2 years’ experience managing associate through senior litigation attorneys.  

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Licensed and in good standing with the State Bar of California with no history of public or private reprisals.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Good computer skills with MS Office (including MS Excel with the ability to create financial/performance reports). 

  • Proficient in the use of applications/programs to create automated reports, templates, systems and data retrieval of high quality and reliability. 

  • Expert knowledge litigating California workers’ compensation matters with trial experience and prior experience handling cases with varying degrees of complexity. 

  • Deep understanding of workers’ compensation administrative rules, laws, statutes, legal principles and practices. 

  • Excellent communication skills (verbal/written). 

  • Ability to communicate effectively with external and internal team members, clients, businesses, and members of the State Bar and Judiciary, including effectively responding to concerns and sensitive matters. 

  • Ability to effectively present information, verbally and in writing, to clients, claims personnel, top management, public groups, Board of Directors, mediators, arbitrators, judges, and juries.

  • Demonstrated experience in working independently under minimal supervision, maintaining a strong work ethic, and exercising initiative.

Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk, and hear.

The Legal Operations & Analytics Manager is responsible for the strategic management of ICW Group's outside (panel) counsel network across all lines of business. This role monitors the annual defense spend on Workers' Compensation, General Liability, Auto Liability, Coverage, and Bad Faith litigation. This position oversees the outside counsel panel, manages a data-driven performance framework to monitor law firm effectiveness and outcomes, governs e-billing and invoice compliance, and identifies opportunities to leverage artificial intelligence and legal technology to improve claim outcomes, enhance operational efficiency, and optimize litigation spend while maintaining defense quality.


Outside Counsel Panel Management & Governance 

  • Provides strategic oversight of ICW Group’s outside counsel panel across insurance offerings encompassing Workers' Compensation, General Liability, Auto Liability, Coverage, and Bad Faith, including panel selection standards, performance expectations, tiering, geographic coverage and specialty expertise.  
  • Leads the Request for Proposal (RFP) process as well as firm onboarding/offboarding. Negotiates rates  including alternative fee arrangements (flat fee, blended rate, success-based structures) where appropriate based on claim severity and complexity. 
  • Serves as the primary relationship owner for panel firms, balancing cost discipline with the need to maintain strong defense relationships and good litigation quality. 

Legal Spend & Budget Management 

  • Manages the Workers' Compensation defense budget and builds out comparable spend visibility and budget ownership for GL, Auto, Coverage, and Bad Faith as programs are onboarded. 
  • Partners with Finance / Claims leadership for quarterly and annual forecasting of outside counsel spend by line of business and severity band. 
  • Identifies and executes cost-reduction opportunities without compromising claim outcomes.  

Performance Analytics & Objective Scorecards 

  • Leads the design, administration, and ongoing refinement of ICW Group's Defense Attorney Scorecard, leveraging objective, weighted KPIs to assess law firm performance, outcomes, efficiency, and cost effectiveness across severity bands. 
  • Translates law firm performance results into actionable panel management recommendations, including counsel assignment, referral, and In-House Counsel utilization strategies. 
  • Partners with Data Science and Analytics to enhance performance measurement frameworks, validating and incorporating emerging indicators of legal outcomes, efficiency, service quality, and litigation effectiveness. 
  • Delivers executive-level reporting and trend analyses on law firm performance, litigation spend, and panel effectiveness, providing strategic insights to Claims leadership and key stakeholders. 

Billing Governance, E-Billing & Compliance 

  • Establishes and oversees outside counsel billing policies and standards, promoting cost discipline, transparency, and compliance across all lines of business. 
  • Conducts billing analytics and invoice audits to identify cost-saving opportunities, improve billing efficiency, and ensure legal services are aligned with agreed-upon engagement standards. 
  • Manages the e-billing program, ensuring efficient invoice processing, effective controls, and clear communication of billing requirements to both internal stakeholders and outside counsel. 

AI & Legal Technology Enablement 

  • Partners with Claim Strategy & Operations and IT to assess, pilot, and deploy AI-driven solutions that improve legal operations, spend management, and litigation efficiency. 
  • Establishes the strategic roadmap for AI adoption within legal operations, prioritizing opportunities to streamline workflows, enhance productivity, and improve organizational outcomes. 
  • Evaluates outside counsel adoption of AI and related legal technologies, incorporating their impact on efficiency, value, and pricing into panel management and engagement strategies. 

Coverage & Bad Faith Program Build-Out 

  • Develops the governance and vendor management framework required to extend ICW Group’s data-driven legal operations model to Coverage and Bad Faith litigation.  
  • Works closely with stakeholders to manage counsel selection, bad faith escalation protocols, and performance monitoring tailed to the unique risk profile of these matters.  

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Reporting 

  • Acts as a strategic connector across Claims, Legal, Finance, and Analytics functions, facilitating data-driven decisions related to outside counsel performance, legal operations, and spend management. 
  • Produces and delivers executive-quality analytics, scorecards, dashboards, and presentation materials that communicate litigation performance, legal spend, and key business trends. 
  • Evaluates evolving litigation trends and market developments across Workers' Compensation, General Liability, Auto Liability, Coverage, and Bad Faith matters, incorporating insights into panel oversight and long-term legal operations strategy.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This role does not have supervisory responsibilities.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field required (or equivalent combination of education and experience).  J.D., paralegal certification, or equivalent legal operations credential preferred.
  • Minimum of 7 years’ experience in legal operations, outside counsel management, or claims litigation management, preferably within a P&C or workers' compensation insurance carrier.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

None required.


KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Strong computer skills with MS Office including advanced Excel required; experience with BI/data tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) preferred.
  • Experience with e-billing and legal spend management platforms and a demonstrated interest in applying AI/legal technology to operational workflows.

Additional Preferred Skills

  • Prior experience building or administering a multi-line-of-business outside counsel scorecard or panel program.
  • Experience piloting or implementing AI-enabled legal or claims technology.
  • Insurance industry experience across multiple lines of business (WC, GL, Auto, Coverage).

PURPOSE OF THE JOB 

The Director of Applied AI Engineering is a senior leader responsible for the delivery and operation of generative and agentic AI solutions across the enterprise. This role leads a team of engineers who design, build, deploy, and support generative and agentic AI capabilities that address business needs in underwriting, claims, distribution, finance, and corporate operations. The Director owns AI Platforms, the shared enterprise capability through which these solutions reach and remain in production, comprising managed foundation model services, agent runtime and orchestration, and machine learning operations. The Director sets engineering standards for generative and agentic AI development and establishes the operating model by which this work is delivered and supported. The Director collaborates closely with data services, cloud and infrastructure engineering, product management, and enterprise risk and governance functions to ensure solutions are well-founded, responsibly deployed, and sustainable in production. 


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Leads the design, development, and production delivery of generative and agentic AI solutions across the enterprise, including generative AI applications, intelligent document processing, conversational interfaces, and agentic and multi-agent workflows. 
  • Owns AI Platforms, including managed foundation model services (Amazon Bedrock), agent runtime and orchestration (Bedrock AgentCore), and machine learning operations — model registry, feature engineering, deployment pipelines, model serving, versioning, evaluation, and production monitoring. 
  • Operates AI Platforms as a shared enterprise capability, onboarding and supporting engineering, analytics, and data science teams as platform tenants and defining the standards and guardrails under which they build. 
  • Establishes and maintains engineering standards for generative and agentic AI development, including prompt and context management, evaluation frameworks, testing practices, documentation, and release management. 
  • Directs the delivery model for generative and agentic AI work, including team structure, capacity planning, and management of commitments to business stakeholders. 
  • Partners with data and AI product management, who own intake and prioritization, to convert the prioritized portfolio into achievable delivery commitments. 
  • Oversees production support for generative and agentic AI solutions, ensuring reliability, performance, and issue resolution within established service levels. 
  • Maintains capacity for applied research and evaluation of emerging generative and agentic AI capabilities, balancing exploratory work against production delivery commitments. 
  • Evaluates emerging generative and agentic AI technologies, foundation models, platforms, and vendors; makes build-versus-buy recommendations and recommends adoption when appropriate. 
  • Partners with enterprise risk and governance functions to ensure generative, agentic, and machine learning solutions complete required review and approval prior to production deployment. 
  • Collaborates with data services teams to define and secure the data products, semantic models, and pipelines required to support generative and agentic AI solutions. 
  • Partners with cloud and infrastructure engineering teams, who own on-premise and cloud hosting, to define the compute, hosting, security, and scaling requirements on which AI Platforms depends. 
  • Partners with financial operations on cost transparency and unit economics for AI Platforms consumption, including token, inference, agent execution, and model cost management. 
  • Translates complex, cross-functional business and integration needs into actionable development requirements, designs, and plans for engineering teams. 
  • Directs the team utilizing KPIs and data to inform decision making. 
  • Monitors and evaluates the performance of generative and agentic AI engineering activities and makes necessary adjustments. 
  • Provides strategic and tactical direction to the team, communicating the organizational mission and values, and setting standards for performance excellence. 
  • Mentors and develops engineering team members, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, and professional growth. 
  • Establishes a collaborative team culture ensuring high engagement, recognition, and retention of team members. Ensures leadership practices promote continuous development and high performance. 
  • Manages hiring, onboarding, and training for incoming staff, setting clear expectations and developing career paths to build a resilient, skilled team. 

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Directly supervises employees within the applied AI engineering and AI Platforms teams and carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with company policies and applicable laws. These responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; conducting performance and salary reviews; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems; coaching, mentoring, and developing team members to further their skills and knowledge; creating and monitoring development plans; setting performance expectations and goals; forecasting staffing needs and planning for peak times and absences; enforcing department policies and procedures. Supervises through subordinate team leads and manages a blend of employee and contract resources.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE 

  • Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field. 
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in software, data, or machine learning engineering, with at least 5 years in a leadership role required. 
  • Experience delivering and operating generative or agentic AI solutions in production environments, beyond pilots or proofs of concept, required. 
  • Experience owning or operating an AI or machine learning platform, including model deployment, versioning, and production monitoring, required. 
  • Experience with generative AI application development, including retrieval-augmented generation, agentic and multi-agent workflows, and model evaluation methods, required. 
  • Experience in insurance or another regulated financial services environment with model governance requirements preferred. 
  • Master's degree in a technical or quantitative discipline preferred. 

LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS 

  • Cloud and machine learning certifications including but not limited to AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified Azure AI Engineer, or other relevant certifications preferred. 
  • Agile certifications including but not limited to Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Certified SAFe practitioner, PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), or other relevant certifications preferred. 

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS 

  • Strong working knowledge of generative and agentic AI architectures, foundation model selection, model lifecycle management, and evaluation methods. 
  • Working knowledge of managed foundation model and agent runtime services, including Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore or comparable platforms, and of the data engineering practices that support retrieval and grounding. 
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage complex engineering initiatives with multiple teams, stakeholders, and dependencies. 
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop engineering team members, with a focus on improving team dynamics and performance. 
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present technical information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Ability to operate effectively where critical dependencies are owned by other teams, working through published commitments and shared prioritization. 
  • Proven ability to manage cross-functional teams and drive change in complex environments. 
  • Strong analytical skills to assess business and technical requirements and develop effective solutions. 

PHYSICAL DEMANDS 

The employee may need to sit in front of a computer for a period of time. While performing the duties of this job, the employee may occasionally need to reach, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee may need to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

PURPOSE OF THE JOB 

The purpose of this job is to provide basic financial, payment and administrative support to the claims department.  The position exists to facilitate efficient operations and a superior customer experience.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Handles incoming, outgoing, and return checks as requested. 

  • Provides administrative support to claims department including mailing checks issued in-house.
  • Reviews incoming checks to determine appropriate department. Identifies type of payment and coordinates with the examiner to apply the payment to the claim as appropriate.
  • Coordinates with accounting to confirm successful deposit of each check.
  • Researches and investigates return checks and re-sends as appropriate.

Performs payment corrections and resolves payment errors as requested. 

  • Obtains appropriate authorization to offset and enter corrected payment transactions per request.
  • Handles payment inquiries from vendors and internal customers.
  • Reviews and resolves payment processing errors.

Performs claim modifications, corrects errors and handles policy notifications as requested.

  • Obtains proper authorization prior to correcting specific claim fields (policy, date of loss, class code etc.).
  • Reviews and resolves claim data integrity errors.
  • Reviews policy endorsement and cancellation notifications to determine the impact to claims.
  • Manages a daily report for all claims opened on the dummy policy and tracks until placed on correct claim.

Reviews Claims data and assists with department initiatives as requested.  

  • Performs a daily review and research of potentially late indemnity payments for each jurisdiction.
  • Reviews content of different state forms (website, letters, claim kits) and escalates as appropriate.
  • Reviews re-insurance monthly, including ceding excess losses in the accounting system.
  • Researches, verifies, and enters data into various systems.
  • Updates department iPortal page when requested.

This role does not have supervisory responsibilities.

High School Diploma or general education diploma (GED) required.  Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college with a major or emphasis in Business Administration, Accounting, Mathematics, or related field a plus.  Minimum 1 year of related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

None required.

The Data Engineer III will design, develop, and implement data pipelines, data integration and data storage solutions such as data warehouses, data lakes, relational and non-relational databases. The role will partner closely with IT Managers, Enterprise Business Intelligence, Data Governance and Data Science teams to solve business-significant data problems and enable data-driven decision-making, automation, and optimization. In the process, the role will have the opportunity to act as a Data Advisory member for the Actuarial, Business Intelligence (BI), Data Science, and Data Engineering teams, as well as a collaborator and contributor to Enterprise Data Architecture. Data is central to ICW Group’s business strategy and digital evolution, and the Data Engineer ensures optimal data delivery architecture is consistent throughout all projects.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Builds data solutions that ensure data integrity and information usability for enterprise-wide digital solutions and decision making.

  • Leads the design and build of scalable data pipelines and solutions (batch and/or streaming) that make the best use of traditional and cloud platforms (AWS or similar) by understanding the business, technology, and data landscape including real time data processing.
  • Provides analysis of complex data elements and systems, data flow and in development of conceptual, logical, and physical data models as well as verification and implementation of ETL/ELT mappings and transformation logic.
  • Designs, supports and peer reviews the data models and schemas for new and existing data sources for the data warehouse.
  • Conducts unit, integration, and system tests on our data sources to validate data against source systems, and continuously optimize performance to improve query speed and reduce cost.
  • Builds the infrastructure required for optimal extraction, transformation, and loading of data from a wide variety of data sources using ‘big data’ technologies and tools.
  • Leads data initiatives to ensure pipelines are reliable, efficient, testable, and maintainable.
  • Maintains a strong understanding of the current landscape and proactively leads the analysis of the current environment to detect data deficiencies, gaps, and opportunities.
  • Drives the improvement of engineering team processes via data architecture, engineering, test, and operational excellence best practices.
  • Collaborates in implementing components of data strategy – Master Data Management (MDM), data virtualization etc.

Partners with various teams in delivering overall data solutions.

  • Works closely with BI and Data Science teams in implementing various data streams.
  • Partners with Enterprise Architecture, Technology, and Project teams to ensure consistency of solutions approach while maintaining data governance requirements.
  • Contributes to data governance and data quality best practices including design reviews, unit testing, code reviews, and continuous integration and deployment.
  • Collaborates with data architects to ensure the output of the physical models meet required needs— e.g., collaborates on data definition, data structure, data content and data usage.
  • Evaluates and conducts POC on new technologies for fitment in next generation data platform ecosystem.
  • Collaborates with the Enterprise Architecture team to drive tooling and standards to improve the productivity and quality of output for data engineers across the company.

SUPERVISORY RESPONISBILITIES

This role does not have supervisory responsibilities but may mentor and/or train other team members. Acts as a resource for team members.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or any other technology related field required, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Minimum 6 years of experience in a data integration (Cloud/Traditional) engineering related role required. Experience with data practices (security, data management and governance) preferred. Experience in operations research, machine learning or optimization a plus. Insurance experience a plus.


CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

  • Data architecture or data engineering related certification strongly desired.
  • AWS Cloud Practitioner or more advanced AWS certification preferred.
  • DAMA certifications preferred.
     

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Expertise with database & data warehouse design, using MS-SQL, PostgreSQL etc.
  • Knowledge of Model and Design of DB schemas for read and write performance.
  • Working knowledge of API or stream-based data extraction processes.
  • Experience performing root cause analysis on internal and external data and processes to answer specific business questions and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Background in data modeling and performance tuning in relational and no-SQL databases.
  • Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, EC2, Glue, EMR, Kinesis, Lambda, DynamoDB, etc.
  • Experience with modern data architectures and modern data platforms like Snowflake, Databricks etc.
  • Experience with data technologies: Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Spark & Kafka Streaming, Python, Scala, Talend etc.
  • Knowledge and experience with data movement tools – SSIS, Profisee, Alteryx, Informatica.
  • Working knowledge of multiple data management domains such as data modeling, integration, warehousing, data quality, security, and governance.
  • A self-starter mentality that thrives in a rapidly changing, fast-paced environment and tolerates ambiguity while demonstrating problem-solving with limited supervision.
  • Strong analytical and time management skills. Self-motivated and able to handle tasks with minimal supervision.
  • Must be organized, detail oriented, and able to multi-task. Ability to work well under pressure and deliver results with tight deadlines and under changing priorities.
  • Ability to cross collaborate with multiple teams and offer value-added solutions to meet objectives.
  • Ability to motivate and inspire team for maximum performance.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.  

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This job operates in a professional office environment.  While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently will sit, stand, walk, and bend during working hours. Requires manual and finger dexterity and eye-hand coordination. Required to lift and carry relatively light materials. Requires normal or corrected vision and hearing corrected to a normal range. Ability to work additional hours, as required.


WORK ENVIRONMENT 

This position operates in an office environment and requires the frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier and other standard office equipment.

Job.JobDescription:
Are you looking to make an impactful difference in your work, yourself, and your community? Why settle for just a job when you can land a career? At ICW Group, we are hiring team members who are ready to use their skills, curiosity, and drive to be part of our journey as we strive to transform the insurance carrier space. We're proud to be in business for over 50 years, and its change agents like yourself that will help us continue to deliver our mission to create the best insurance experience possible.


Headquartered in San Diego with regional offices located throughout the United States, ICW Group has been named for the twelfth consecutive year in a row and for the 20th time overall as a Top 50 performing P&C organization offering the stability of a large, profitable and growing company combined with a focus on all things people. It's our team members who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. We strive to make both our internal and external communities better everyday! Learn more about why you want to be here!


PURPOSE OF THE JOB 

The purpose of this job is to handle all aspects of workers’ compensation cases with varying degrees of complexity and to provide other litigation and claim legal advice and services to all areas of the company. This role exists to provide high quality, proactive case handling utilizing legal expertise and litigation skills to independently handle a caseload of high exposure cases and complex litigation matters and deliver optimal results for ICW Group. 


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Provides litigation services and is responsible for all aspects of assigned Workers’ Compensation matters.

  • Manages the entire legal process, from investigation and discovery though trial prep and court proceedings, depositions, site inspections, court hearings, trials, etc. and negotiating settlements as required.
  • Litigates workers’ compensation cases in California before all state and federal courts, administrative boards, and other court proceedings.
  • Represents ICW Group, its related entities and insureds before administrative boards, state and federal courts, Court of Appeal, and the California Supreme Court.
  • Handles premium audit disputes before administrative boards or other court proceedings.
  • Assists in subpoenas and other third-party discovery.
  • Analyzes complex legal and factual issues; conducts extensive, well-reasoned legal research, as necessary; independently develop and present defense strategies on behalf of ICW Group.
  • Responsible for the prompt, efficient and effective disposition of assigned cases.

Provides accurate legal analysis and strategy recommendations to clients and claims personnel.

  • Assists in analyzing, reviewing, and distributing information on new legislation, regulations, court decisions and proceedings.
  • Provides strategic legal advice, recommendation, and implementation of clear, cost-effective, and efficient plans of action.
  • Delivers ongoing quality assessments of the law and facts and recommendations for timely resolution.
  • Analyzes all referrals from claims and determines need for outside investigation or other information from the insured or others.
  • Provides effective and timely communications, information, legal advice, and other services to clients and claims professionals on legal and factual issues.
  • Develops appropriate legal strategies for all stages of litigation and shares them with claims personnel and clients.

Provides leadership through mentoring other attorneys and legal support staff.

  • Directs paralegals and other legal department staff in their duties and responsibilities in handling cases.
  • Ensures timely filing of all pleadings and motions or other documents with the court or administrative broads.
  • Builds and fosters internal and external client relationships with a customer-centric focus.
  • Adheres to all ICW Group’s policies and procedures and the California Rules of Professional Conduct.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES 

This role does not have direct supervisory responsibilities. Position will direct the work of support staff, which may include assistants and paralegals, in accordance with company policies and applicable laws, including the California Rules of Professional Conduct.  These responsibilities include planning, assigning, and directing work; review, revise and approve legal documents; delegate tasks to the appropriate staff member; train, coach, and mentor, as appropriate, support staff to ensure the delivery of quality legal services.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE 

Bachelor’s degree from four-year college or university required.  Juris Doctorate (JD) from an accredited law school required. Minimum 7-10 years of workers’ compensation litigation experience or equivalent combination of education and experience required.


CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS 

Licensed and in good standing with the State Bar of California required, with no history of public or private reprisals.


KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Expert knowledge in litigating California workers’ compensation matters with trial experience and prior experience handling cases with varying degrees of complexity.  Must have a deep understanding of workers’ compensation administrative rules, procedures, laws, and statutes.  Familiarity with business legal principles and practices is necessary, including knowledge of billing practices and procedures.  Demonstrated experience in working independently under minimal supervision, maintaining a strong work ethic, and exercising initiative.  Ability to communicate effectively with external and internal clients both verbally and in writing.  Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical documents, legal materials of all types, and medical records.  Strong negotiation and communication skills.  Ability to respond to inquiries, issues, or questions from internal and external clients, businesses, and members of the State Bar or Judiciary, and regulatory agencies, including effectively responding to the most sensitive inquiries or concerns.  Ability to effectively present information, verbally and in writing to clients, claims personnel, management, mediators, arbitrators, judges, juries, and members of the public.  Proficient use of a personal computer and skills with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, Adobe, and PowerPoint.  Ability to learn various proprietary computer applications.  Ability to work with mathematical concepts and apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and algebra and geometry to practical situations.  Ability to combine pieces of information to form general rules or conclusions and problem-solve.  Ability to define legal issues, collect necessary data, establish facts, draw legal conclusions, and implement a strategic legal resolution.  Expert at time management skills, appropriate delegation of activities and the ability to manage multiple legal matters at one time. 


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS  

Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk, and hear.  


WORK ENVIRONMENT  

This position operates in an office and court environment and requires frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier, scanner, and other standard office equipment.  The position requires traveling to various court locations as well as other business locations.

PURPOSE OF THE JOB 

The purpose of the position is to partner with key stakeholders to drive the strategic direction for a portfolio of insurance product line(s) across all distribution channels and brands.  This position helps define product strategy and roadmap and champions the strategy and monitors product progression throughout the full life cycle. The position is responsible for monitoring and influencing all aspects of product performance to achieve Company revenue and performance targets.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Ideates and develops business initiatives using product knowledge and results.

  • Leads and participates in collaborations with the head of product line underwriting unit(s) to develop product strategy and action plan to achieve growth and profit objectives.
  • Owns inputs to bi-annual premium and exposure projections supporting financial budgeting and pro-forma processes and understand projection framework.
  • Provides expert insights regarding profitability, retention, and growth strategies through the integration of the underwriting, marketing, policyholder services, distribution, claims, actuarial, data analytics, customer, and digital experience.
  • Collaborates with other functional departments to coordinate timelines for delivery, maximize the effectiveness of programs, direct implementation of product strategies, and drive cross-functional alignment and engagement for initiatives supporting product objectives.
  • Develops and maintains templates to perform competitive research and deliver competitive analyses.
  • Utilizes and trains others in the use of internal analytical tools (spanning underwriting, marketing, customer behavior, and claims). 
  • Performs and reviews data analyses concerning loss patterns, market forces, risk distributions, and agency management to evaluate the success of current strategies to either modify or create new strategies targeting production, product pricing, underwriting, contract changes, or agency changes.
  • Assesses the impact of changes on the in-force book, new business production, and agency force.

Develops and drives initiatives for strategic product development.

  • Applies business content knowledge in identifying priorities and executing strategic product initiatives to achieve business objectives.
  • Monitors the marketplace to identify competitor and industry changes impacting effectiveness or compliance of current and proposed programs.
  • Partners with Actuarial team to determine and implement appropriate pricing and program structure to achieve product goals, and design and execute product rate plan and state level enhancements across jurisdictions ensuring all changes are communicated to field services, operations, underwriting, marketing, and system technology teams.
  • Partners with Underwriting team to facilitate changes to processes or systems, or respond to questions, and ensuring communication to affected parties.
  • Analyzes the performance of existing products; develops and leads the creation of business cases for the development of changes to existing products or development of new products.
  • Maintains knowledge of available internal and external data sources, including accuracy and completeness, to select the proper data set(s) for evaluation.
  • Organizes and structures product definitions to ensure efficiencies in downstream reporting processes.
  • Directs the implementation of underwriting guideline changes.
  • Collaborates with strategic planning groups to incorporate enterprise class system solutions supporting the future product roadmap.

Acts as product leader and subject matter expert in the maintenance of current products, filed product changes, and design and delivery of new products in development.

  • Develops internal partnerships and collaborates with Enterprise Marketing, Legal, Compliance, Underwriting, and Actuarial Departments to manage the implementation of all ratemaking bureau rules, forms and coverage changes, and company-initiated changes including coordination with the rate filing analyst.
  • Keeps abreast of distribution channel needs through involvement in agency facing initiatives, and regular reporting on direct to market strategies available in the industry.
  • Possesses expert knowledge of ratemaking bureau underwriting manuals and company exception rules and maintains knowledge of any changes.  Documents and memorializes changes.
  • Researches issues or concerns around underwriting rules, including historical company filings in independent ratemaking bureaus to confirm adherence and direct changes.
  • Maintains knowledge of rules, regulations, nuances in states of operation and engage with product line underwriting unit(s) to invoke needed changes or identify training in support of a self-sustaining culture.
  • Proactively engages with Underwriting and Legal to ensure insurance policy provisions comply with state law.
  • Partners with Compliance Department to identify and close any gaps in rules, respond to changes in rules, and remediate across systems, processes, reporting.
  • Participates in regulatory approval of filings, market conduct exams, and internal responses to any state filing objections to facilitate modifications.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES 

This position has no supervisory responsibilities but may mentor and train junior team members. 


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree from a college or university required with a major or emphasis in Business, Computer Science, Math, or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.  MBA is a plus. 
  • Minimum 6 years of experience in insurance product management.  Insurance industry knowledge and demonstrated work experience required. 
  • Exposure to industry recognized product management curriculum, or demonstrated experience required. 
  • Experience managing complex, large-scale, high risk product development projects preferred.  

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Extensive knowledge of insurance industry; workers compensation or commercial lines required based on role designation.
  • Resourcefulness to research industry topics and develop proficient knowledge of internal systems and constraints to aid in managing individual state compliance.
  • Knowledge of actuarial practice area is a plus.
  • Highly developed quantitative analysis, decision making, and project management skills. 
  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex business problems, consistent with a deep understanding of the strategic direction of the business. 
  • Deep knowledge of the insurance product lifecycle, financial drivers of profitability, insurance regulations and general insurance operations and business processes.
  • Ability to synthesize analytical results to guide business decisions. Strong leadership, written and oral communication, and teamwork skills required.  Strong organizational skills. 
  • Ability to hold effective meetings, including setting agendas and attendees, time management, and documentation of meeting outcomes.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS 

Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter (CPCU) preferred. 


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit or periodically stand and work on a computer for 80-90% of time.  The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms and climb or balance.  The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 5 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.  


WORK ENVIRONMENT  

This position operates in an office environment and requires the frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier, and other standard office equipment. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The purpose of the Actuarial Specialist is to produce complex analyses, manage projects, and oversee team workload to meet high levels of service within the Actuarial department. This position exists to support and execute Company strategy as directed by the Chief Actuary, while acting as a team leader and as a trusted advisor to other business leaders.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Provides technical analyses and participates in process development.

  • Provides technical actuarial analyses in the areas of ratemaking, reserving, analytics, and systems integration.
  • Participates in the development and documentation of actuarial department processes.
  • Takes responsibility to modify processes in order to improve accuracy and efficiency.
  • Develops new business processes or comprehensive analytic efforts.
  • Initiates project design within system constraints and demonstrates an understanding of dependencies.

Works with business leaders to develop and implement new products and expand into new markets.

  • Buildout of the Commercial Property pricing model.
  • Acts in the capacity of a trusted advisor to other business leaders.
  • Ensures that the work product supports business growth and profitability.
  • Takes a prominent role in communicating and explaining actuarial findings to business leaders.
  • Fosters positive, collaborative working relationships with higher level experts across the organization.
  • Works with individuals in other departments in fulfilling the actuarial role within larger projects.

Assists in developing the actuarial team and oversees subordinates’ work.

  • Maintains a positive work climate and fosters motivation and engagement.
  • Performs at the level of a subject matter expert and a team lead for a functional area (e.g. regulatory/filings, corporate including reserving, systems administrator, pricing, ratemaking).
  • Ensures soundness and integrity of actuarial analyses.
  • Reviews subordinate’s work to uphold consistency with Standards of Practice and provides valuable feedback.

Excess & Surplus Specific:

  • Supports development and enhancement of pricing tools for E&S product lines.
  • Performs individual large complex accounts pricing review and works closely with E&S underwriters.
  • Provides business requirements for system integration and set up data export functions for data reporting.
  • Builds business reports to monitor rate change and profitability of the portfolio.
  • Evaluates and refines pricing assumptions based on industry benchmark data and competitive analysis.
  • Demonstrated success in Commercial Lines (Property, GL, Auto, and etc.) and/or E&S market environments.
  • Proficient in Excel, Python and SQL; expert in actuarial and statistical modeling techniques. Experienced with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
  • Strong technical pricing skills with knowledge of exposure-based pricing, experience modelling, catastrophe modelling and stochastic simulation techniques.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This role does not have supervisory responsibilities but may act as a team lead and mentor actuarial analysts.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university required in Applied Mathematics, Computer Science or related field. 
  • Minimum 5 years of related experience in actuarial roles required.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

ACAS designation highly desired but relevant work experience may be considered.


KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills and proven project leadership abilities.
  • Thorough knowledge of actuarial models and ability to assess results.
  • Thorough knowledge of broad segments of ICW systems and related business areas.
  • Experience managing multiple projects and resources.
  • Dedication to building a working knowledge of emerging analytic techniques.
  • Ability to work independently in deriving solutions to new business problems.
  • Comfortable and competent in client interaction settings.

Position will direct the work of support staff, which may include assistants and paralegals, in accordance with company policies and applicable laws, including the California Rules of Professional Conduct.  These responsibilities include assigning, and directing work; review, revise and approve legal documents; delegate tasks to the appropriate staff member; train, coach, and mentor, as appropriate, support staff to ensure the delivery of quality legal services.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE 

Bachelor’s degree from four-year college or university required.  Juris Doctorate (JD) from an accredited law school required. Minimum 5 to 8 years of workers’ compensation litigation experience or equivalent combination of education and experience required.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS 

Licensed and in good standing with the State Bar of California required, with no history of public or private reprisals.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Proficient knowledge in litigating California workers’ compensation matters with prior experience handling cases of various types.  Must have a solid understanding of workers’ compensation administrative rules, procedures, laws, and statutes.  Familiarity with business legal principles and practices is preferred, including knowledge of billing practices and procedures.  Demonstrated experience in working independently under minimal supervision, maintaining a strong work ethic, and exercising initiative.  Ability to communicate effectively with external and internal clients both verbally and in writing.  Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical documents, legal materials of all types, and medical records.  Strong negotiation and communication skills.  Ability to respond to inquiries, issues, or questions from internal and external clients, businesses, and members of the State Bar or Judiciary, and regulatory agencies, including effectively responding to the most sensitive inquiries or concerns.  Ability to effectively present information, verbally and in writing to clients, claims personnel, management, mediators, arbitrators, judges, juries, and members of the public.  Proficient use of a personal computer and skills with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, Adobe, and PowerPoint.  Ability to learn various proprietary computer applications.  Ability to work with mathematical concepts and apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and algebra and geometry to practical situations.  Ability to combine pieces of information to form general rules or conclusions and problem-solve.  Ability to define legal issues, collect necessary data, establish facts, draw legal conclusions, and implement a strategic legal resolution.  Expert at time management skills, appropriate delegation of activities and the ability to manage multiple legal matters at one time. 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS  

Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk, and hear.  

WORK ENVIRONMENT  

This position operates in an office and court environment and requires frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier, scanner, and other standard office equipment.  The position requires traveling to various court locations as well as other business locations.

PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The purpose of the Product Business Support Specialist is to partner cross functionally in the execution of insurance product design, implementation, and project management. This role will facilitate effective planning and execution of product business solutions that align to overall department and company strategy. This role will serve as a liaison between business and technology subject matter experts to coordinate and implement projects and solutions to meet business needs.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Provides project management for product business solutions, from end-to-end, to ensure that project objectives are met.

  • Partners with business leaders and executives to identify gaps in processes, write requirements and define project roadmap(s) aligned with company strategy.
  • Elicits, analyzes, and documents detailed business solutions that arise from changes across multiple teams and systems.
  • Works with business partners to plan and convert project roadmap(s) into phases and workstreams.
  • Gathers rates, rules, and forms requirements (proprietary or ISO based) from Product and Actuarial teams and coordinates with IT and Underwriting (UW) implementation liaison(s) as needed to align regulatory filings and effective dates across multiple systems.
  • Coordinates updated requirements as filing objections may change rates, rules, or forms implementation.
  • Works with business and technical subject matter experts to track dependencies and gaps in processes and clearly define and document solutions.
  • Works with participating business and technical teams to ensure proper resource allocation to achieve the successful outcome of product business solutions.
  • Creates touch points and provides updates to stakeholders regarding project objectives, schedule, status, conflicts, and dependencies.
  • Pro-actively monitors project activities, resource constraints, and working team progress. Communicates with IT and other partners any issues that require attention.

Coordinates Product and Actuarial user acceptance testing (UAT) and user access to appropriate environments.

  • Coordinates test case documentation with UW and Product and logs test case results.
  • Ensures test errors are reported with appropriate documentation to IT partners.
  • Follows up with IT for timing and resource availability for testing fixes with business subject matter experts.
  • Provides support for UAT and test defect resolution. Coordinates and documents test cases and results to ensure accurate and timely reporting and re-testing of issues.

Supports implementation of product business solutions and provides post-implementation support of deployed business solutions.  

  • Participates in coordinating the deployment and implementation of business solutions for product changes as they relate to rates, rules, and forms.
  • Partners with PMO, IT, and Underwriting in planning and execution to align deployment deliverables.
  • Communicate with LOB partners to resolve and align expectations where there are shared system impacts.
  • Fast tracks progress of internal development work and provides support for feature enhancements, including documentation, and project management.
  • Provides ongoing production support, including responding to user issues, collaborating with technical teams to analyze and resolve reported issues.
  • Assigns, documents, and tracks business issues as they evolve through the entire implementation life cycle, ensuring resolution. Escalates delays and roadblocks and works with SMEs to ensure system implementation and business processes are aligned on effective dates and filed and approved for rates, rules, and forms.

SUPERVISORY RESPONISBILITIES

This role does not have supervisory responsibilities.


EDUCATION AND SKILLS

  • Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university required with a major or emphasis in Business, Information Technology, Insurance, or related field. Additional experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
  • Minimum 5 years of insurance experience required.
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant technical insurance product (rates, rules, forms) experience required.
  • Project management experience in prior roles desired.  

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

  • Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter (CPCU), Associate in Insurance (AINS) or other insurance industry designation desirable. Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Project Management Professional (PMP), or CAPM certifications a plus.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Knowledge of the insurance end-to-end process.
  • Understanding of dependencies, process when changes are made in one area that affects others downstream.
  • Outstanding communication and documentation skills, in both business process and technical formats required. 
  • Expertise in project management techniques is foundational. 
  • High level business knowledge in at least one functional business area is expected. 
  • Working experience interacting with Information Systems and Technical Engineers is essential.
  • Strong analytical skills, ability to create compelling business cases; Team-oriented focus; ability to conduct effective meetings with business and project teams; ability to create and interpret business user needs into specifications.  
  • Understanding of the insurance product implementation lifecycles and experience in writing business requirements and business test specifications.
  • Working knowledge of Jira, Confluence and Visio preferred.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This job operates in a professional office environment.  While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently will sit, stand, walk, and bend during working hours. Requires manual and finger dexterity and eye-hand coordination. May be required to lift light objects. Requires normal or corrected vision and hearing corrected to a normal range.

This position operates in an office environment and requires the frequent use of computer, telephone, copier and other standard office equipment.

PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The Manager Claims supports Insurance Company of the West’s mission to create the best insurance experience by driving operational excellence, ensuring regulatory compliance, and fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and service. This position leads a high‑performing team responsible for delivering exceptional claim outcomes and  customer experience. The manager ensures performance metrics are met while partnering closely with internal stakeholders to reduce claim costs, improve injured worker outcomes, and strengthen policyholder relationships. This role works cross functionally to drive the overall claims strategy. This position will oversee the Claims Support Services department, guiding strategic initiatives, supporting team development, and ensuring consistent, effective service delivery across all areas of responsibility. This role will lead a team of Claims Support Services Supervisors, fostering a collaborative, customer-focused environment while developing future leaders to deliver high-quality service and operational excellence across the claims department.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Operational Excellence

  • Monitors key performance indicators (KPIs) such as claim duration, reserve accuracy, litigation rates, and customer satisfaction.
  • Analyzes trends and provide actionable insights to improve outcomes and reduce loss costs.
  • Partners with Quality Assurance, Training, and other internal teams to strengthen processes and elevate claim quality.
  • Supports audits, compliance reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

 

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Builds strong relationships with policyholders, brokers, medical providers, and legal partners to support claim resolution and service excellence.
  • Collaborates with Underwriting, Risk Management, and Safety to address claim drivers and support policyholder retention.
  • Ensures clear, timely communication with injured workers to support recovery and return‑to‑work efforts.

 

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Works closely with other Claims managers to ensure consistency, alignment, and shared best practices across the department.
  • Participates in strategic planning, department initiatives, and enterprise projects that enhance ICW Group’s claims operations.

Claims Oversight & Strategy

  • Oversee the full lifecycle of workers’ compensation claims, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant handling.
  • Ensure adherence to jurisdictional requirements and ICW Group best practices.

Develops and leads a team of claims professionals to ensure daily operational success

  • Provides guidance to Team Members. Communicates Mission, Values, and other organization operating principles to direct reports.
  • Establishes and maintains the overall work cadence and, in partnership with department leadership, ensures performance and outcomes strive for excellence in delivery and customer experience.  Ensures that the entire team is engaged and that leadership practices encourage development, recognition, and retention.
  • Establishes and adheres to hiring criteria, on-boarding, and training requirements for incoming staff.
  • Manages performance and supports Team Member development through goal setting, coaching, and ongoing feedback for direct reports.
  • Acts as a resource for team members to answer questions and solve complex problems.
  • Manages budget, technology and other resources, workload, and customer requests for Department services. 
  • Maintains compliance with all Company policies, procedures, and assigned responsibilities.
  • Safeguards data quality, follows IT security guidelines, and monitors risk-related metrics.

 

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

Directly supervises 2 or more employees within the Claims team and carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with company policies and applicable laws. These responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; conducting performance and salary reviews; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems; coaching, mentoring, and developing team members to further their skills and knowledge; creating and monitoring development plans; setting performance expectations/goals; forecasting staffing needs and planning for peak times and absences; enforcing department policies and procedures.

 

 

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university (or equivalent combination of education and experience) along with a minimum of 5+  years’  related workers’ compensation claims experience required. At least one year supervisory or management experience of claims professionals required; may require claims adjuster experience (depending upon the team this position will lead).  Prior multi-state claims insurance with experience managing high volume caseloads.

 

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Insurance Education Association (IEA) Certificate, Workers Compensation Claims Professional (WCCP) Accreditation preferred. Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter (CPCU) designation a plus.

 

 

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Good computer skills with MS Office products, claims management systems,  databases with the ability to learn new software programs and tools
  • Advanced understanding of Workers’ Compensation claims principles and applications
  • Solid interpersonal skills with the ability to develop good working relationships
  • Excellent  communication skills (verbal/written), time management and organizational skills.
  • Must be able to effectively present information to direct reports, peers, management and public forums.  
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
  • Experience with process improvement methodologies, optimizing workflows and operational excellence programs
  • Demonstrated ability to distill complex information into clear, actionable guidance.
  • Must have data‑driven decision‑making and a high level of attention to detail.
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS 

Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk, and hear. 

WORK ENVIRONMENT 

This position operates in an office environment and requires the frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier, and other standard office equipment. Travel up to 15% is required.

This role acts as the bridge between business stakeholders, development teams and end-users, ensuring clear communication and effective prioritization of features and enhancements throughout the product lifecycle.  


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Drives organizational goals and maximizes the value of the PVMS Technology.

PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The purpose of the Managing Attorney is to oversee the operational aspects for the Litigation Management team working closely with the department Director.  This role will create, manage and improve operational processes, as well as assist with budget planning, financial measures and results. The Managing Attorney will identify and lead initiatives to improve the team’s efficiency and ensures effective communication between the legal and business teams.  This role acts as both a Litigation Attorney with a reduced case count and manages a staff of Litigation team members.  The position works autonomously and under the general supervision of the Litigation Management’s department Director.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Directs the operations of law office personnel providing litigation and legal services.

  • Oversees law office operations to ensure efficient operations of In-House Counsel.
  • Contributes to strategic business decisions to achieve company goals.
  • Ensures the firm is achieving its client satisfaction goals by evaluating productivity and quality of service. 
  • Identifies, makes recommendations for work process improvements and follows through to implement remediations. 
  • Works with management to ensure the department meets financial and ROI goals, identifies trends, prepares reports, and implements modifications as needed.
  • Mentors less experienced attorneys, law clerks, paralegals and assistants to help them advance in the field of law by continuing to expand their knowledge, skills and abilities.

Provides litigation services and is responsible for all aspects of assigned Workers’ Compensation matters.

  • Handles a reduced caseload of litigated files and ensures files are fully worked and moved to resolution.
  • Litigates workers’ compensation cases in California before all state and federal courts, administrative boards, and other court proceedings.
  • Represents ICW Group, its related entities and insureds before administrative boards, state and federal courts, Court of Appeal, and the California Supreme Court.
  • Analyzes complex legal and factual issues; conducts extensive, well-reasoned legal research, as necessary; independently develops and presents defense strategies on behalf of ICW Group.
  • Provides strategic legal advice, recommendation, and implementation of clear, cost-effective, and efficient plans of action.
  • Assists in analyzing, reviewing, and distributing information on new legislation, regulations, and court decisions.

Provides oversight of a team of Litigation Management professionals.

  • Supervises and evaluates, mentors, motivates, and develops associate attorneys, paralegals, law clerks, hearing representatives, and support staff to strengthen our legal team.
  • Communicates clear performance expectations for associate attorneys, paralegals, law clerks, hearing representatives, and support staff as well as providing support and guidance for achieving expectations.
  • Expands the substantive expertise of associate attorneys, paralegals, law clerks, hearing representatives.
  • Communicates and enforces team values including mission statement of In House Counsel (IHC) and ICW.
  • Establishes and maintains the overall work cadence and, in partnership with Department leadership, ensures performance and outcomes strive for excellence in delivery and customer experience.
  • Acts as a resource for team members to answer questions and solve complex problems.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

Directly supervises employees within the Litigation Management team and carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with company policies and applicable laws. These responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; conducting performance and salary reviews; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems; coaching, mentoring, and developing team members to further their skills and knowledge; creating and monitoring development plans; setting performance expectations/goals; forecasting staffing needs and planning for peak times and absences; enforcing department policies and procedures.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Bachelor’s degree from four-year college or university required.  Juris Doctorate from an accredited law school required.  Minimum 8-10 years of workers’ compensation legal experience required.  1-2 years supervisory experience of one or more of the following roles: associate attorneys, paralegals, law clerks, hearing representatives or support staff required.


CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Licensed and in good standing with the State Bar of California with no history of public or private reprisals.


KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Expert knowledge litigating California workers’ compensation matters with trial experience and prior experience handling cases with varying degrees of complexity.  Deep understanding of workers’ compensation administrative rules, laws, statutes, legal principles and practices.  Ability to work with Excel including skilled at creating financial and performance reports.  Ability to communicate effectively with external and internal team members, clients, businesses, and members of the State Bar and Judiciary, including effectively responding to concerns and sensitive matters.  Proficient use of applications and programs to create automated reports, templates, systems and data retrieval of high quality and reliability.  Excellent oral and written communication skills.  Skilled at logical thinking to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.  Consistently maintains professional and appropriate demeanor, works harmoniously with others and responds positively to feedback. Ability to effectively present information, verbally and in writing, to clients, claims personnel, top management, public groups, Board of Directors, mediators, arbitrators, judges, and juries. Demonstrated experience in working independently under minimal supervision, maintaining a strong work ethic, and exercising initiative.


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS 

Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk, and hear. 


WORK ENVIRONMENT 

This position operates in an office, home, and court environment and requires frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier, scanner, and other standard office equipment.  The position requires traveling to various court locations and works at one of the offices of In-House Counsel on a weekly basis.
