This is an exciting opportunity for a blended role for Manager, Data Science within our Data Product space. The Manager Data Science is responsible for architecting, building, and deploying production-grade machine learning models, AI solutions, and data products while leading a team of advanced data professionals. This is a highly technical, hands-on role that requires a combination of strong experience developing scalable solutions and zero to one product launch moving them from concept through production. This role requires hands-on technical contribution and is not solely an oversight function.

The ideal candidate has demonstrated experience building data products and operationalizing machine learning within a cloud environment such as Azure, AWS, or similar platforms. This role requires comfort working with modern data architectures, integrating data pipelines, and managing the full lifecycle of models and AI applications. This individual has expertise in machine learning, statistical modeling, and data visualization to translate business needs into actionable insights. You will guide a team in applying best practices for model assessment, feature engineering, and scalable deployment while collaborating across business functions to ensure alignment with organizational goals. 

The position works closely with key business stakeholders and development teams and operates within the full software development lifecycle to deliver secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions. This individual is expected to contribute directly to technical design, development, and deployment efforts while ensuring best practices across architecture, performance, and model lifecycle management.

This is a remote position.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, build, train, and deploy production-grade machine learning models, AI solutions and data products
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify high impact opportunities and deliver data driven solutions that support strategic goals
  • Design and implement data visualization solutions to effectively communicate complex insights to business stakeholders
  • Translate business requirements into actionable data science projects aligned with organizational strategy
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to identify data sources, ensure data quality, and deploy scalable models into production environments
  • Develop a framework to monitor model performance post-deployment and recommend adjustments to maintain accuracy and robustness
  • Stay ahead of industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in data science and AI
  • Partner with engineering teams to build and support data pipelines using technologies such as Azure Data Factory or comparable tools
  • Work closely with development teams across the full SDLC, ensuring solutions are production-ready, secure, and maintainable
  • Play a key role in architectural decisions, technical design reviews, governance frameworks for models and implementation strategies
  • Communicate model behavior and results into actionable insights to business and technical stakeholders
  • Manage a team of highly technical data and AI professionals to complete project deliverables and provide guidance on modeling techniques, feature engineering, and data analysis methods
  • Foster a high-performing team culture through coaching, mentoring, and professional development
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Strong technical expertise in machine learning and AI solution development
  • Experience building and deploying data products in production environments
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or similar ecosystems
  • Familiarity with ML lifecycle management, data pipeline orchestration, and production support
  • Solid understanding of software engineering principles and development workflows
  • Ability to write, review, and optimize Python and SQL code
  •  Deep understanding of Large Language Model (LLM) orchestration, specifically how to build "Agents" that can reason, use tools, and execute workflows autonomously
  • Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns, including how to manage embeddings, vector indexing, and the "chunking" of unstructured data for AI consumption
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate complex models to business users
  • Excellent presentation skills

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Data Science, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or related discipline). Master’s degree preferred
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in data science, ideally in a data product capacity in banking/finance, insurance or a related field

CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Medical Case Manager position in Rogers, AR.  

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.  

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families.  Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others.  This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides in-person and telephonic Medical Case Management to individuals, involving the patient, physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient’s progress
  • Evaluates patient’s treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney’s visits
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, etc. for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy
  • Conducts home visit for initial evaluation
  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker’s injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month 
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Additional duties as required

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers
  • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
  • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets

The Telephonic Case Manager coordinates resources and develops cost-effective, personalized care plans for ill or injured individuals. The goal is to support quality treatment and, when appropriate, a timely return to work. This role uses clinical expertise to assess the appropriateness of current treatment plans based on the patient’s medical and physical condition. The Case Manager communicates directly with treating physicians to evaluate and recommend alternative care options when needed. They also explain medical conditions and treatment plans to patients, family members, and adjusters, while supporting the objectives of the Case Management department and of CorVel.

This is a remote role.

This position requires a California RN Nursing License.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide medical case management to individuals through coordination with the patient, the physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Provide assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient's progress
  • Evaluate patient's treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Utilize medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan/alternate treatment plans with the physician
  • Make medical recommendations of available treatment plans to the payer
  • Implement care such as negotiating and coordinating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • Devise cost-effective strategies for medical care
  • Required to prepare organized reports within a specified timeframe
  • Minimum Productivity Standard is 95% per month
  • Additional duties as assigned

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to meet designated deadlines
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize MS Office including Excel spreadsheets
  • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

    • Bachelor’s degree required, BSN preferred
    • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
    • Current RN Licensure in state of operation

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Nurse Case Manager, Medical & Managed Care (Workers Comp)
Job.JobDescription:
CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Medical Case Manager position in Folsom, CA.  

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.  

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families.  Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others.  This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides in-person and telephonic Medical Case Management to individuals, involving the patient, physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient’s progress
  • Evaluates patient’s treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney’s visits
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, etc. for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy
  • Conducts home visit for initial evaluation
  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker’s injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month 
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Complies with all safety rules and regulations during working hours in conjunction with the Injury and Illness Prevention Program (“IIPP”)
  • Additional duties as required

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers
  • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
  • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience as an RN Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred
  • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
  • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
  • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications preferred
  • A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required 

PAY RANGE:

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.  The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Job.JobDescription:
CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Medical Case Manager position in <>.  

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.  

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families.  Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others.  This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides Medical Case Management to individuals through in person and telephonic communications with the patient, physician, other health care providers, employer and others.
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans.
  • Evaluates patient’s treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness.
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation and evaluation of patient’s progress. 
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney’s visits. 
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, et cetera for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy. Initial home visit for initial evaluation.
  • Implements care such as negotiation the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services. 
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker’s injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month 
  • This role may require overnight travel.

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
  • Experience as a RN, Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred.
  • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, and advisors/clients and coworkers.
  • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful.
  • Strong interpersonal, time management and organizational skills.
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize MS Office including Excel spreadsheets.
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment.
  • Bilingual

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Graduate of accredited school of nursing.
  • Current RN Licensure in state of operation.
  • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications are preferred.
  • A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required. 

PAY RANGE:

SUMMARY

Salesforce experience preferred

Intermediate skills in Microsoft Excel

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Ability to prioritize work for multiple projects and deadlines

Responsible for advising Alliant corporate departments and business groups on a broad range of legal issues and managing outside counsel when needed. Reviews, drafts, and negotiates a variety of contracts and other forms, in addition to other general corporate and compliance matters. policies, processes, and procedures to increase efficiencies and support business objectives.

Develops and gives presentations to various corporate groups and management on best practices with regard to contracting, legal compliance, and other legal matters.

Law School Juris Doctor degree from an ABA-accredited law school is required

Five (5) or more years of related work experience is required

Member in good standing of at least one State Bar or the District of Columbia Bar is required

Experience in effectively preparing, drafting, reviewing, and negotiating contracts with minimum supervision.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Ability to give legal guidance in a practical, business-oriented manner to non-lawyer company representatives in order to help reach solutions

Advanced analytical, problem-solving, and time management skills

Demonstrated business acumen with ability to inspire trust and confidence with senior management

Demonstrated leadership skills and ability to adapt skills based on context and environment

Strong interpersonal skills and ability to establish good professional relationships with internal clients,

management, and legal colleagues

Excellent planning, organizational, and prioritization skills, including ability to multitask on multiple high-priority projects

Good judgment, including good business judgment

Strong contract drafting and negotiation skills

Proficient in Microsoft Office products

SUMMARY 


The General Sales Manager is responsible for the overall recruiting and development of a designated sales unit within a branch office, and meeting personal and branch office production in support of the profitable growth and success of the branch office.



ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  


Performs regular, in person outside sales activity selling products within a specific line of business directly to clients to meet both personal production as well as branch office production requirements for consumer sales. 


Responsible for leadership of the unit to ensure the branch office achieves the goals and objectives as reflected in the Business Plan for the branch office including sourcing, recruiting, developing, supervising, supporting and retaining the agents/advisors. 


Train new agents with company's marketing systems, illustration and planning tools; as well as sales appointment training with an emphasis on working jointly with unit agents (resulting in split commissions) and the establishment and implementation of minimum sales requirements.


Monitor performance against goals and adhere to budget guidelines and approved annual marketing or business unit plans.


Establish, oversee and/or participate with annual goal setting, including revenue and recruiting goals based upon sales projections and annual marketing or business plans for the business unit.


Presentations at appropriate meetings to include ongoing initiatives as well as future plans to be implemented, accurate reporting, reviewing objectives, reviewing progress, identifying needs or areas for improvement and action plans for correction


Perform all duties in accordance with all company policies and procedures, and all federal, state and local laws, wherein the Company operates.


Performs other duties as assigned

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE 


Bachelor's Degree in financial services or marketing, or an equivalent combination of education, industry training, designations and experience.


Two (2) or more years of successful insurance sales and/or management at a field or home office level.


Must have a strong sense and knowledge of sales and marketing concepts that are beneficial to the sale of insurance products.


Securities Licensing preferred but not required (Series 6, 63, 7, 24, 26 or 65).

Working knowledge of federal, state and local laws as well as industry regulations.


Working knowledge of insurance services industries, concepts, and principles.


Knowledge of the general industry procedures, standards, systems, resources, practices and terminology.

SUMMARY 

Responsible for serving as the primary operational liaison between company, independent insurance producers, employer groups, and carrier partners. Provides consultative support throughout the customer lifecycle including new business development, implementation, enrollment, ongoing service, renewals, and carrier administration. Acts as an extension of the General Agency and carrier service teams by delivering operational support, resolving service issues, coordinating implementations, educating producers, employers and employees, and supporting the growth and retention of General Agency business.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Builds and maintains trusted relationships with assigned brokers, agencies, carrier partners, and employer groups to promote retention, growth, and exceptional service.

Serves as the primary day-to-day General Agency contact for assigned producers and carrier partners.

Supports producer-led new business efforts including quoting, plan recommendations, proposal preparation, RFP responses, and quote-to-card coordination.

Reviews and scrubs new business submissions for completeness and accuracy prior to carrier submission.

Coordinates new group implementations, installation activities, enrollment timelines, and carrier onboarding requirements.

Conducts or participates in employer implementation meetings, employee education meetings, benefit presentations, and open enrollment meetings in partnership with producers and carrier representatives.

Facilitates renewal activities including proposal preparation, alternative plan options, plan design changes, and renewal strategy discussions.

Provides first-line operational support by researching and resolving eligibility, billing, claims, pharmacy, ID card, provider directory, plan change, member add/termination, reinstatement, ancillary product, and other service-related issues using carrier service platforms whenever possible.

Assists producers and employer groups with carrier portals, eServices, Employee Navigator, connectivity, and other enrollment or technology platforms.

Coordinates resolution of complex service issues and appropriately escalates matters that cannot be resolved through established carrier resources.

Maintains working knowledge of carrier products, underwriting guidelines, administrative procedures, technology platforms, and regulatory requirements affecting General Agency operations.

Supports producer education by delivering training on carrier products, processes, enrollment tools, and General Agency resources.

Collaborates with carrier sales and service teams to implement new products, initiatives, and strategic growth opportunities.

Maintains accurate documentation and utilizes agency management systems and other technology platforms to support operational excellence.

Exercises sound judgment in balancing producer advocacy with carrier requirements while ensuring a high-quality customer experience.

Performs all duties in accordance with all company policies and procedures, and all federal, state and local laws, wherein the Company operates.

Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

Five (5) or more years related work experience  

Valid Insurance License

Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills

Ability to conduct producer, employer and employee meetings

Excellent customer service skills

Good analytical, problem solving and time management skills

Ability to be organized and to prioritize work for multiple projects and deadlines

Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, agency management systems, carrier portals and enrollment technology

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst with solid expertise in personal and/or commercial residential property insurance to support and enhance our Policy and/or Claims Administration systems. This role will partner with business stakeholders and technology teams to analyze workflows, define requirements, support system enhancements, and resolve production issues that impact critical insurance operations.

This position may be filled at the BA I, BA II, or BA III level, depending on the candidate’s experience, skills, and demonstrated ability to work independently, lead initiatives, and influence outcomes. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, regulated environment with evolving priorities.

Essential Functions:

Business & Systems Analysis

  • Partner directly with Underwriting, Product, Operations, Compliance, Claims, and Technology teams to gather and document business requirements
  • Translate underwriting and/or claims guidelines, eligibility rules, rates, forms, endorsements, and workflows into functional system requirements
  • Support enhancements and configuration of online quote/bind applications and policy/claims administration systems
  • Create user stories, business process flows, requirement documentation, acceptance criteria, and traceability artifacts
  • Analyze impacts of product or regulatory changes to system functionality and business processes
  • Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned to support business objectives.

Project Delivery & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Participate in or lead requirements workshops, discovery sessions, and backlog refinement meetings.
  • Manage changing priorities and scope while ensuring requirements remain clear, documented, and approved.
  • Participate in testing validation, defect triage, and production implementation activities
  • Provide clear, timely communication and status updates to stakeholders.

Documentation & Quality Assurance

  • Create and maintain documentation while ensuring Confluence is consistently updated and serves as the single source of truth for requirements including workflows, business rules, system behaviors, and configuration details.
  • Develop and execute test plans, track defects and coordinate fixes.
  • Ensure delivered solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and compliance expectations.

Production Support & Issue Resolution

  • Troubleshoot system issues, identify root cause, and coordinate resolution with IT and development teams.
  • Support production incidents and escalated help desk tickets related to our systems.
  • Communicate issue status, risks, and resolution progress effectively to business partners.
  • Review escalated Service Desk tickets to identify opportunities for process improvement, knowledge base development, and training, facilitating the transition of repeatable support activities and issue resolution from higher support tiers to Level 1 Service Desk teams.

Qualifications

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
  • Professional experience in the Property & Casualty Homeowners and/or Residential Commercial insurance industry functioning in a Business Analyst capacity, including requirements elicitation, documentation, and collaboration with technical teams to implement changes to insurance or policy administration systems.
  • Proven experience analyzing business problems, troubleshooting issues, and applying logical, detail-oriented approaches to develop effective solutions with limited supervision.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple assignments simultaneously, prioritizing work, managing scope, and driving work to completion with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.
  • Demonstrated experience working with cross-functional teams, business stakeholders, and technical resources, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience working in Agile / Scrum or sprint-based delivery environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in a Business Analyst role within the Property & Casualty insurance industry.
  • Experience supporting Homeowners and/or Residential Commercial lines of business for Florida, Texas, and/or California risks, including familiarity with state-specific products, forms, rating, underwriting, or regulatory requirements.
  • Experience with Duck Creek.
  • Familiarity with regulated environments such as Florida and/or Texas.
  • Insurance carrier or MGA background strongly preferred.
  • Business Analyst certification (CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA) a plus.

Essential Skills:

  • Ability to understand technical concepts and communicate effectively with developers and system vendors.
  • Strong attention to detail especially when working with policy, forms, rating, claims, or billing system changes.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to evaluate business needs and translate them into clear, well-defined requirements.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining accountability for quality and timeliness of deliverables.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to research issues, recreate steps, identify root causes, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Ability to understand complex business processes, system workflows, and dependencies.
  • Proficiency with business analysis, documentation, and collaboration tools used to support project delivery.

Position Summary: 

We are seeking a strong, hands-on Network Engineer to join our IT infrastructure team. Reporting to the Senior Network Engineer, this role owns the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and improvement of the company's network, firewall, and connectivity infrastructure across on-premises data centers and a growing Microsoft Azure environment, including the Cisco compute fabric, NetApp storage networking, and Palo Alto security platforms that support it. The ideal candidate is a deeply technical engineer with strong fundamentals, disciplined troubleshooting, and excellent documentation.

Work Location:
This is a full-time, in-person position based at our Boca Raton, Florida office. Remote and hybrid work arrangements are not available for this role.

Technical Environment: 

  • Security: Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls (PAN-OS) across on-premises data centers and Azure, GlobalProtect VPN, Cloudflare, and Zero Trust / network access control.
  • Switching and compute fabric: Cisco Catalyst campus switching and Cisco Nexus (NX-OS) data-center switching; Cisco UCS X-Series (chassis, Fabric Interconnects, Intersight).
  • Routing and WAN: BGP, OSPF, and EIGRP across a multi-site WAN (MPLS / DIA circuits) with site-to-site IPSec VPN.
  • Storage networking: NetApp ONTAP (FAS / AFF) with SnapMirror replication; Tintri.
  • Cloud: a substantial and growing Microsoft Azure networking footprint (hub-and-spoke VNets, peering, VPN Gateway, Azure Firewall, NSGs, and user-defined routes).
  • Wireless and monitoring: UniFi wireless; Site24x7 monitoring.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operate, maintain, and monitor enterprise LAN, WAN, and UniFi wireless infrastructure across multiple sites.
  • Administer Palo Alto Networks firewalls (PAN-OS), including security policy, NAT, threat prevention, URL filtering, and GlobalProtect VPN; tune App-ID and SSL / TLS decryption.
  • Design, implement, and support Microsoft Azure networking, including hub-and-spoke VNets, peering, VPN Gateway, Azure Firewall, NSGs, and user-defined routes.
  • Configure and troubleshoot routing and switching (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP) across Cisco Catalyst and Cisco Nexus (NX-OS) switches and the Cisco UCS X-Series Fabric Interconnect environment in a multi-site network.
  • Build and maintain site-to-site IPSec VPN connectivity with business partners and vendors.
  • Support NetApp ONTAP storage networking and replication.
  • Administer network monitoring platforms; maintain alerting, dashboards, NetFlow, and device-health visibility.
  • Administer and support network security applications and Zero Trust / network access control.
  • Respond to network alerts and incidents; perform root-cause analysis and permanent remediation.
  • Participate in planned maintenance windows, including change preparation, verification, and rollback procedures.
  • Create and maintain network documentation, diagrams, IP address management (IPAM), and runbooks.
  • Install, rack, and cable network hardware; support equipment lifecycle and refresh projects.
  • Assist with network security tasks, including certificate management, vulnerability remediation, and access reviews.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation.

  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays

  • Collaborative and growth focused culture

  • 5+ years of hands-on network engineering or network administration experience.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP fundamentals, including subnetting, routing, NAT, DNS, and DHCP.
  • Production experience with enterprise-class routers and switches, including Cisco Catalyst, Cisco Nexus (NX-OS), and Cisco UCS X-Series Fabric Interconnects.
  • Hands-on production experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls (PAN-OS), including security policy, NAT, and VPN.

Position Summary:

Windward Risk Managers is seeking a highly skilled System Administrator to serve as the primary administrator for backup, recovery, and cloud infrastructure across the company’s on-prem and cloud environments. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Veeam, vCenter, and Microsoft Azure, with a focus on continuously improving, optimizing, and validating data protection and high-availability architecture. This role leads disaster-recovery planning and testing in partnership with the Systems, Network, Database, and Security teams to keep business-critical systems protected and recoverable.

Work Location:
This is a full-time, in-person position based at our Boca Raton, Florida office. Remote and hybrid work arrangements are not available for this role.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Continuously improve and evolve the company’s disaster-recovery environment across our data centers and Azure; lead DR planning, runbooks, and failover testing, engaging the Systems, Network, Database, and Security teams; configure fault-tolerant features and maintain Recovery Time Objective and Recovery Point Objective documentation.
  • Design, implement, and optimize the Veeam Backup & Replication environment, including job architecture, repositories, replication, retention and immutability policies, and storage usage.
  • Administer the VMware vSphere / vCenter environment as it relates to data protection, including replication and recovery validation, along with the supporting SAN / NAS storage (NetApp, Tintri), deduplication appliances (ExaGrid), and immutable backup repositories.
  • Validate backup integrity through regular restore testing and automated verification; confirm all critical systems are covered, configurations follow best practices, and gaps are remediated.
  • Contribute to the company’s business continuity program, supporting business impact analysis, recovery strategies for critical business functions, and the ongoing maintenance and testing of business continuity plans as infrastructure and systems change.
  • Manage and expand the company’s Microsoft Azure footprint, building out cloud infrastructure to support business continuity, backup, and DR targets while maintaining storage, access control, and cost governance as adoption grows.
  • Monitor backup health, capacity, and SLA compliance; perform root cause analysis on failures and implement preventive measures.
  • Support compliance and audit requirements related to data protection, backup retention, and recoverability, including evidence gathering and remediation of audit findings.
  • Automate verification and reporting with PowerShell; maintain runbooks and documentation; serve as the escalation point for backup and recovery issues.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for data protection, storage management, and recovery operations.

Why Windward Risk Managers:

  • Windward Risk Managers is proud to be recognized on Fortune's 2026 Best Medium Workplaces list, ranking #28 among the Top 100 companie
  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees
  • Up to 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting
  • Long-term and short-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support
  • Collaborative and growth focused culture

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • 5 to 8 years of systems administration experience in a hybrid (cloud and on-premises) environment.
  • Hands-on production experience designing and managing Veeam Backup & Replication and VMware vSphere / vCenter environments.
  • Administrator-level experience with Microsoft Azure (resources, access control, storage, cost governance).
  • Solid understanding of backup and disaster-recovery concepts, including Recovery Point Objective and Recovery Time Objective, replication, snapshots, immutability, and DR testing.
  • Practical PowerShell scripting skills; working knowledge of Windows Server and enterprise storage (NetApp and / or Tintri preferred).
  • Strong problem-solving skills, the ability to prioritize effectively, and clear written and verbal communication.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Veeam Certified Engineer (VMCE)
  • VMware Certified Professional (VCP) or Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104)

Why Join Marshall+Sterling?

As a 100% employee-owned company with roots dating back to 1864, Marshall+Sterling offers the strength of a time-tested organization and the energy of an ownership-driven culture. Guided by our mission to empower clients to predict, prepare for, and preempt risk, we are relentlessly focused on helping people and businesses protect what matters most — so they can move forward with confidence. Our vision of creating a future that’s safer and more secure drives everything we do.

Innovation is not optional here — it's imperative. We constantly seek better, smarter ways to serve our clients and improve as a company. Collaboration is at our core, because we know we are stronger together — across teams, with our clients, and in the communities we serve. Our employee-owners are not only valued and empowered, but also directly invested in our collective success. 

At Marshall+Sterling, you’re not just joining a company — you’re joining an inclusive culture built on integrity, impact, and people-first values. Your ideas matter, your growth is prioritized, and your work helps shape a more secure future for all.

This role is based in our Poughkeepsie Office.

We’re looking for a people-focused Account Manager who can combine relationship-building with sharp benefits expertise to help create a future that’s safer and more secure for our clients. In this role, you’ll manage your own book of business, work closely with our producers and executives, and deliver the kind of client experience that inspires trust and long-term partnerships.

If you’re passionate about making complex benefits feel simple, supporting clients through every stage of their journey, and mentoring others to grow alongside you—you’ll thrive here.

  • Manage your own book of business—acting as the go-to contact, ensuring smooth operations, and delivering outstanding service.
  • Partner with Account Executives and Producers to design benefits strategies, prepare renewals, and grow client relationships.
  • Lead client meetings including open enrollments, benefit presentations, and planning sessions—both in person and online.
  • Build strong carrier relationships to secure the best solutions for each client.
  • Create and maintain client materials like benefits guides, presentations, and communication pieces using Microsoft Office and HRIS tools.
  • Stay ahead of industry changes by keeping up-to-date on regulations, compliance requirements, and best practices.
  • Mentor Assistant Account Managers, providing guidance to help them succeed.

Qualifications

 

  • A four-year college degree in business or related field
  • Proficiency in AI tools and Microsoft Office programs.
  • Must have own transportation or access to reliable transportation and maintain a valid driver's license throughout employment.
  • This position requires a NYS P+C brokers license.

Total Rewards Package:

Compensation: $50,000 - $70,000, based on experience.

Benefits: Comprehensive package including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with match, Generous Paid Time Off (PTO), thirteen paid holidays, company-paid life insurance for you and your dependents, employee assistance fund and programs, wellness perks, and more!

Employee Stock Ownership Program

As a 100% employee-owned company, Marshall+Sterling offers you the unique opportunity to build long-term wealth while growing your career. Here’s what makes our ESOP so valuable:

  • Long-Term Rewards: The value of your ESOP account grows over time, rewarding your commitment and contributions to the company’s success.
  • Collaborative & Engaged Culture: Employee ownership fosters a team-oriented environment where everyone has a stake in the company’s growth and success.
  • No Out-of-Pocket Costs: Unlike stock purchase plans, our ESOP is entirely company-funded, meaning you gain equity without any personal investment.

For more information on our culture and benefits, please visit us at : Careers - Marshall+Sterling

Job Summary

The Marketing Strategy Lead partners with the Small Business and Middle Market teams to translate business priorities into actionable B2B marketing strategies, plans and initiatives. With a focus on agency relationships, sales enablement and agent engagement, this role helps communicate Westfield's value, equip agents and agency-facing teams, and support profitable growth. Working across Sales, Product, Underwriting, Research & Insights, Communications, Digital and Creative teams, the role connects business objectives to coordinated marketing execution.

The position is responsible for developing strategic marketing plans, identifying marketing opportunities, creating project briefs, managing campaign budgets and coordinating the execution of marketing initiatives. Strong strategic thinking, relationship building, project management and the ability to influence and move work forward through others are critical to success.

This is an individual contributor role that combines B2B marketing expertise and strategic thinking with hands-on planning, coordination and execution.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develops B2B marketing and sales enablement strategies, content and resources that equip agency-facing teams and agents to effectively communicate value, identify opportunities and support customer conversations.
  • Develops and executes strategic marketing plans with business unit leaders to align sales plans, profitable growth and forecasts with meeting business unit goals.
  • Identifies new and/or improves existing marketing strategies, proactively evaluates marketing opportunities, interprets agent, customer and consumer needs and leverages best-in-class market research and analytics/customer analytics.
  • Assesses marketing opportunities and develops, implements and measures appropriate programs to advance marketing strategy. Utilizes all traditional and innovative marketing channels, including digital, mobile and social media.
  • Helps turn strategy into a sales plan for various business units and defines the market position of the business unit in relation to strategic objectives, value proposition, differentiators, agent and customer engagement experience, etc.
  • Works in alignment with business unit product management, channel strategy and portfolio assurance responsibilities to determine capability requirements and opportunities for the marketing plan.
  • Defines and monitors success and control measures, monitors business unit functionality and makes deliverable management and control conclusions.
  • Uses customer and end-user insights, market and competitor analysis to identify target market and business unit opportunities for profitable growth.
  • Conducts fact-based market analysis to systematically evaluate, prioritize and recommend marketing opportunities to grow business in line with corporate and business unit objectives.
  • Develops and maintains a segment value proposition based on a comprehensive understanding of consumer and market dynamics.
  • Collaborates effectively with business unit teams and corporate functions to set and align segment marketing/value proposition vision, strategy and roadmap with corporate strategy with the focus on target markets, customer propositions and experiences, marketing strategy and innovation.
  • Employs an agile mindset and acts as a change leader integral to developing the organization's understanding of segment strategy, engaging and educating stakeholders on the overall strategy and related benefits.

Job Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Marketing or a related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing or a related field and/or commensurate work experience.

Licenses and Certifications

  • Certified Marketing Management Professional (CMMP)

Location

Job Summary

The Claims Senior Representative-Property Field serves as a technical expert on claims adjusting. The role determines coverage and investigates, analyzes, negotiates, and settles claims not requiring outside investigation. The role delivers quality customer service in a high volume, moderate complexity work environment and mentors less experienced Adjusters on the team. Westfield Property Claims resolves first party personal, commercial, and agriculture property claims, including structural damage, business and personal property, and business income losses.

Job Responsibilities

  • Determines whether proper coverage exists for the type of claim assigned. 
  • Investigates thoroughly to obtain relevant facts concerning all aspects of the claim, such as coverage, legal climate, potential exposure, and damages, and makes decisions on claim resolution. 
  • Meets established goals & objectives, arranges for salvage disposition and other recovery proceedings as necessary, participates in claim file reviews and audits with customer and broker. 
  • Provides support in negotiation of settlements with insureds, claimants, vendors, attorneys, and other insurance companies. 
  • Manages approved vendors and counsel utilized as necessary in the claim process, including approval of investigation plans and budgets. Monitors, reviews, and issues payments to vendors and counsel in accordance with guidelines and standards. 
  • Supports to review proper reserves for each claim based upon thorough investigation, evaluation, and experience. 
  • Identifies and refers all claims to management for further handling and assignment instructions. 
  • Refers claims exceeding authority to appropriate manager or complex claims specialist with recommendations. 
  • Formulates sound recommendations for claims file handling, subsequent transactions, and renewal processing.
  • Requests additional information from an agent, identifies the need for referral to the field based on underwriting guidelines. 
  • Maintains effective and ongoing communication with insureds, claimants, agents, attorneys, other insurance companies, representatives, vendors, and company personnel. 
  • Completes appropriate reports to ensure that the claim status is clearly documented, obtains all necessary documentation to support claim evaluation. 
  • Interprets complex and detailed documents such as contracts, legal documents, insurance regulations and policies as needed. 
  • Maintains knowledge of related coverage, law, and legislative environment and trends, participates in professional industry groups staying abreast of industry changes and advancements and incorporates best practices. 
  • Adjusting first party homeowners and commercial property claims.
  • Efficient in use of Xactimate to evaluate first party property claims.  
  • For field roles only: Travels as often as needed including regular utilization of assigned fleet vehicle in order to cover assigned territory. This may involve traveling on short notice or other daily driving duties as assigned. May be required to travel for extended periods to fulfill storm duty responsibilities. 

Job Qualifications

  • 4+ years of Claims Handling experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Communication, or a related field and/or commensurate work experience.
  • For field roles only: Valid driver’s license and a driving record that conforms to company standards.

Location

Remote 

Licenses and Certifications

  • Certified Professional Claims Management (CPCM) (preferred)

Behavioral Competencies

  • Collaborates
  • Communicates Effectively
  • Customer Focus
  • Decision Quality
  • Nimble Learning

Technical Skills

  • Account Management
  • Claims Investigations
  • Claims Adjustment
  • Financial controls
  • Case Management
  • Customer Relationship Management
  • Project Management
  • Business Process Improvement
  • Auditing
  • Data Analysis and Reporting

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Underwriting Assistant, Underwriting, Training & Development Specialist
Job.JobDescription:
We are seeking an Underwriting Trainee to join our Financial Institutions team based in the Chicago, IL office.  Westfield Specialty’s Underwriting Training Program (UTP) is a 2 year program that provides an entry level opportunity for individuals with the drive to become successful members of our underwriting team. While working within the structure of a formalized training program, trainees will learn underwriting practices by participating in formal as well as on-the-job training. Developing a working knowledge of product language, underwriting practices, policies and guidelines.  Upon successful completion of the training, underwriting trainees will continue to work with their team to understand Westfield Specialty’s Underwriting process and perform basic underwriting functions in a market-facing or product underwriting role.

Trainee Program Objectives

Industry/Practice/Knowledge

  • Demonstrates broad knowledge of the business, the marketplace and company goals, objectives and performance measures through the effective delivery of all products and services.

  • Links line of business policies and practices to company strategies.

  • Demonstrates forms and coverage knowledge and applies them to exposure.

  • Compares company coverages to competitors and differentiates our company from others.

  • Identifies new product opportunities.

Book Management/Pricing Skills

  • Manage assigned territory so that items such as renewals, endorsements (if applicable), claim reviews and related transactions are completed accurately within accepted company timelines.

  • Applies standard pricing to exposures.

  • Applies individual loss and expense factors, when applicable.

Risk Selection

  • Applies underwriting strategies and standards to pre-qualify risk acceptability.

  • Performs detail analysis utilizing appropriate information (exposure/rate/financial & loss) to determine account acceptability, taking customer needs into consideration.

Desired Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s degree required; recent graduates majoring in Finance or Economics are strongly preferred.  

    • Graduation date must be no later than June 2027

  • Demonstrated interest in financial markets and/or financial institutions. 

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. 

  • Strong attention to detail, coupled with initiative and the ability to thrive in a fast‑paced team environment. 

  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to build effective working relationships. 

  • Proven ability to work both independently and collaboratively. 

  • Flexibility to adapt to shifting priorities and manage multiple tasks simultaneously. 

  • Highly motivated with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and follow‑through.

Please note- the salary for this role is 70k.  This role is also eligible for discretionary incentive pay.

Job.JobTitle: Small Business State Product Management Analyst
Job.JobDescription:
Job Summary

The Small Business State Product Management Analyst will be accountable in supporting the growth and profitability for assigned states and/or insurance product lines(s). The role will analyze internal and external trends to propose data-driven recommendations to influence key performance metrics.  The analyst collaborates closely with underwriting, sales, actuarial, marketing, and other cross-functional departments to ensure products meet profitability, compliance, and customer satisfaction goals.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without employer sponsorship.

Job Responsibilities

  • Independently conduct and understand data analysis of business results to assess profitability and growth opportunities and identify root cause. 
  • Formulate and execute potential recommendations to drive desired growth & profitability impacts based on established strategy with consideration for local regulatory nuances, and broader marketplace dynamics. 
  • Present, inform and influence product and pricing recommendations to business partners including underwriting and sales.
  • Collaborate with Actuarial, Underwriting, and Sales during rate review process to align rate and pricing with Countrywide and local market profit and growth strategies.
  • May function as a subject matter expert in strategic initiatives to support the goals and objectives of the broader organization. 
  • Develops top and bottom-line forecasts and rigorously analyzes and evaluates product performance metrics against those plans to identify divergence from expectations. Recommends actions based on actual results and builds contingency plans.
  • Monitor effectiveness of business initiatives and strategies, impacts to rate and pricing changes, book mix changes, and any outliers in trends; then provide recommendations on potential course of actions.
  • Demonstrates excellent problem-solving abilities, in a practical way, to balance between addressing root cause and introducing changes in fast order.
  • Acquires market and competitive intelligence and develops knowledge of emerging trends to effectively compete in a rapidly changing environment and shares knowledge with the organization.
  • Develops a deep understanding of the regulatory and statutory environments for assigned states and/or lines of business. Ensures product decisions and processes are in alignment with company policies and meet all legal and regulatory requirements.

Job Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience in Product Research, Insurance industry or a related field.
  • Bachelor's degree in market research, statistics, data science, business, or a related field and/or commensurate work experience.

Location

  • Hybrid- defined as working three or more days per week in the office if the employee's residence is within 50 miles of Westfield Center, OH; OR Remote-if the employee resides more than 50 miles from Westfield Center, OH.

Behavioral Competencies

  • Certified Market Research Professional (CMRP)
  • Collaborates
  • Customer focus
  • Communicates effectively
  • Decision quality
  • Nimble learning
  • Certified Analytics Professional (CAP)

Technical Skills

  • Business Requirement Gathering
  • Technical Documentation
  • Data Reporting and Analysis
  • Product Development Lifecycle
  • Business Analysis
  • New Product Development
  • Market Research
  • Product Analytics

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Manager / Director, Underwriting, Commercial Lines Underwriter
Job.JobDescription:
Job Summary

The Commercial Lines Underwriting Manager is responsible for leading a team of commercial lines’ underwriters handling medium-touch / high-touch new and renewal business that requires underwriting expertise and individual risk decision making aligned to the Commercial Lines appetite. The role is responsible for productivity, prioritization, balancing of workloads, and sound underwriting decisions of their team of underwriters. The role is also responsible for handling underwriting referrals exceeding the authority limits of team members. The role ensures alignment and collaboration with the Underwriting Operations Team and Territory Managers/Leaders, driving a culture of virtual teaming to ensure achievement of territory plans and targeted financial results. The role is responsible for coaching and mentoring team members along with continuously growing the overall underwriting acumen on the team and its members, while also focusing on driving the business development practices and acumen that will ensure the achievement of territory objectives.

Job Responsibilities

  • Leads a team of Commercial Line underwriters handling medium-touch / high-touch new and renewal business that requires underwriting expertise and individual risk decision making aligned to the Commercial Lines appetite.
  • Manages productivity, prioritization, balancing of workloads, and sound underwriting decisions of their team of underwriters.
  • Handles underwriting referrals exceeding the authority limits of their team members. Exercises underwriting authority to achieve profit through quality risk selection and exposure control.
  • Ensures alignment and collaboration with the Underwriting Operations Team and Territory Managers/Leaders, driving business development best practices in the underwriting environment, aligned to field operations.
  • Partners with Territory Leader/Managers ensuring alignment to territory strategy & vision, creating a shared accountability and team environment for underwriting, underwriting support, and territory partners.
  • Ensures efficient, consistent, quality underwriting decisions and ensures adherence to compliance of all underwriting rules and policies.
  • Utilizes knowledge, experience, technical underwriting and subject matter expertise to coach and mentor team members. Performs talent management responsibilities including employee selection, performance management, coaching in technical and career development, employee-related issues, employee morale and work environment.
  • Partners with the QA underwriting function, utilizing findings to help develop underwriting acumen and decision making of the team.
  • Works to increase the overall business and underwriting acumen of the team and its members through one-on-one interactions (e.g., reviewing underwriting decisions, answering questions, listening to phone calls).
  • Ensures individual authority grants for underwriters are established following a well-calibrated, objective, data-driven process.
  • Participates in professional industry groups and stays abreast of industry changes, advancements, and jurisdictional issues to communicate, develop, and incorporate best practices in Commercial Lines.

Job Qualifications

  • 6+ years of Commercial Lines Underwriting experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in related field and/or commensurate work experience.

Licenses and Certifications

  • Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter (Preferred)
  • Property And Casualty Insurance License (Preferred)

Location

Hybrid- defined as working three or more days per week in the office if the employee's residence is within 50 miles of Westfield Center, OH; OR Remote-if the employee resides more than 50 miles from Westfield Center, OH.

Behavioral Competencies

  • Collaborates

  • Customer Focus
  • Decision Quality
  • Nimble Learning
  • Builds Effective Teams
  • Business Insight
  • Develops Talent
  • Directs Work
  • Ensures Accountability
  • Manages Complexity

Technical Skills

  • Commercial Lines Underwriting
  • Insurance Industry Knowledge
  • Data Analysis and Reporting
  • Automation
  • Customer Service Management
  • Insurance Policies
  • Risk Management
  • Business Planning
  • Information Systems

Job Summary

The Small Business Senior/Lead Underwriter owns their territory and partners with the Territory Manager to execute strategic priorities, drive profitable growth, and support retention. They apply our Underwriting Philosophy by balancing individual risk characteristics, agency performance, and portfolio health to make informed underwriting decisions. As trusted advisors to their agency partners, they provide guidance and solutions that strengthen relationships, support mutual success, and deliver consistent value to customers and the business.

The role leverages strong underwriting expertise, critical thinking, problem-solving acumen, portfolio management skills, data and analytics, and creativity to make informed risk decisions, optimize territory performance, and improve business outcomes. The Senior/Lead Underwriter is expected to demonstrate strong workload management, agency partnership, and support continuous improvement while serving as a resource and mentor to peers within the underwriting organization. The role makes responsible decisions regarding risk acceptability and pricing, escalates issues as needed, and provides leadership with insights on market trends, agency opportunities, and operational improvements. The Senior/Lead Underwriter embraces change, demonstrates adaptability, and serves as a champion for new processes, technologies, and ways of working to support the evolving needs of the organization and our agency partners.

Job Responsibilities

  • Manages an assigned portfolio of business consistent with underwriting strategies, profitability objectives, growth targets, retention goals, and customer experience expectations.
  • Effectively prioritizes and manages a high-volume workload across multiple agencies, balancing production, the agency experience, underwriting integrity, responsiveness, and business objectives.
  • Collects, analyzes, and evaluates underwriting information to make sound risk selection, pricing, and coverage decisions consistent with company appetite and strategy.
  • Operates as a Trusted Advisor by developing strong relationships with agencies, producers, and other distribution partners to understand business objectives, identify opportunities, and drive profitable outcomes.
  • Leverages portfolio underwriting principles, analytics, business intelligence, and market insights to identify trends, opportunities, and actions that optimize territory performance.
  • Owns their territory by collaborating with Sales, Product, Operations and key business partners to align strategies, address challenges, and achieve profitable growth, retention, and territory objectives.
  • Leverages underwriting expertise, business acumen, and creative problem-solving to deliver solutions that balance agency needs with company objectives. Partners and negotiates with agents to achieve profitable outcomes, strengthens agency relationships, and contributes to agency business planning and growth strategies.
  • Provides leadership with feedback and recommendations on market conditions, competitor activity, agency performance, product opportunities, pricing trends, and emerging business needs.
  • Identifies and implements opportunities to improve operational efficiency, streamline underwriting processes, and enhance agency and customer experiences.
  • Actively embraces and leverages technology, digital capabilities, automation tools, and innovation initiatives to improve underwriting effectiveness and business results.
  • Builds and maintains effective communication internally and externally regarding underwriting practices, agency strategies, growth objectives, and service expectations.
  • Collaborates with corporate and shared service partners to execute business strategies and deliver a seamless customer and agency experience.
  • Champions organizational change by adopting new processes, technologies, and ways of working while helping agency partners and teammates successfully navigate change in a growing and evolving organization.
  • Serves as a resource for peers by sharing knowledge, promoting best practices, supporting onboarding efforts, and contributing to the development of underwriting excellence across the team.

Job Qualifications

  • 5+ years of Commercial Underwriting experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field and/or commensurate work experience.

Licenses and Certifications

  • Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter (CPCU) (Preferred)
  • Property And Casualty Insurance License (PCIL) (Preferred)

Location

Hybrid- defined as working three or more days per week in the office if the employee's residence is within 50 miles of Westfield Center, OH; OR Remote-if the employee resides more than 50 miles from Westfield Center, OH.

Behavioral Competencies

  • Collaborates
  • Communicates Effectively
  • Customer Focus
  • Nimble Learning
  • Ability to Influence
  • Builds Effective Relationships
  • Adaptability

Technical Skills

  • Commercial Lines Underwriting
  • Underwriting Strategy
  • Risk Management
  • Portfolio & Territory Management
  • Data Analysis & Business Insights
  • Critical Thinking & Problem Solving

Job Summary

The Treasury Operations Senior Analyst, working under minimal supervision, is responsible for ensuring the efficient and effective management of the company's cash and investments. This role supports the Treasury Operations department by performing the following: managing the execution of transactional processes, collecting, and reviewing data, posting general journal entries, reconciling accounts, reporting, and administering financial institutional relationships and various ongoing financing and treasury programs. The Senior Analyst partners with Accounting, Tax, Legal, and other internal departments to ensure the timely and accurate execution of treasury activities, appropriate accounting treatment and reporting of financial transactions, and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and internal controls.

The role also serves as a peer mentor to less experienced staff and subject matter expert in the department.

Job Responsibilities

  • Supports the development, implementation, and maintenance of the company's cash management strategies and policies to optimize cash flow, minimize borrowing costs, and maximize investment returns.

  • Leads daily cash management, treasury operations, and related accounting functions, ensuring accurate transaction processing, reconciliation, financial reporting, and compliance with established policies and controls.

  • Serves as the lead contact for treasury and accounting matters, providing support and issue resolution, facilitating treasury service changes with banking partners and other internal departments and offering guidance on the accounting, reporting and control requirements of treasury activities.

  • Supports month-end cash reconciliation activities and variance resolution. Investigates discrepancies, updates financial records, and communicates with business partners to resolve issues.

  • Oversees the daily investment trading settlement activity of multiple legal entities and employee benefit programs; developing, implementing, and performing procedures to calculate and execute various transactions, within limits of authority and/or investment portfolio guidelines.

  • Verifies and maintains all purchase, sale, and income information of companies’ investment portfolios to ensure the integrity of the portfolio records and financial reporting.

  • Drives improvements to treasury-related systems and procedures by documenting requirements, leading testing efforts, resolving escalated user or data issues, and ensuring alignment with accounting practices, internal controls, and treasury objectives.

  • Collaborates with Leader and assists with development and monitoring all processes and controls in the treasury area. Recommends changes and provides continuous improvements to ensure operating and financial controls are of industry best practice standard.

  • Enhances cash management policy and process improvements to support efficient treasury operations and regulatory compliance.

  • Develops and implements treasury risk management strategies and policies to identify, mitigate, and manage financial risks.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Sales Manager, Insurance Sales, Insurance Sales Representative
Job.JobDescription:
Job Summary:

The Sales Senior Territory Manager working under limited supervision, is responsible for implementing the Business territory strategy in their assigned distribution channel territory. The responsibilities include driving profitable business growth and sales, meeting annual growth targets, overseeing marketing and production of insurance products within their territory. The role serves as the representative of the Company in specified territory, actively engaging with agencies, networking, and participating in the local community to raise brand awareness. The role also manages agency relationships, leverages knowledge of the territory as a competitive advantage, gets involved in strategic territory planning, analyzing performance, gaining a deep understanding of the risks faced, staying updated on industry trends affecting the insurance business, and developing expertise in insurance products. This role collaborates closely with underwriting (UW) and product management teams to ensure profitability targets are met at both agency and territory levels, intervening to redirect agency behavior when required.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Executes the Business territory strategy in their designated territory and handles marketing, business development, and achieving annual growth targets for insurance products in the assigned territory.
  • Collects, analyzes, and interprets sales data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities, including examining sales reports, customer data, market research, and other relevant information to gain insights into sales performance.
  • Represents and promotes the company within the territory through agency visits, networking, and community involvement. Identifies specific opportunities within each agency and connects them with appropriate company resources.
  • Provides necessary support (e.g., underwriting, training, troubleshooting) to agencies to foster trust, comfort, and brand loyalty to the company. 
  • Collaborates with Distribution Management team in agency planning and customized compensation. Assists in identifying the need for new agencies in the territory and contributes to the agency selection process.
  • Uses their territory knowledge as a competitive advantage, focusing on territory planning, performance analysis, understanding risks, identifying industry trends, and building expertise in insurance products.
  • Gathers competitive and market intelligence through agency engagements and networking, sharing insights with Business Territory Leader and other stakeholders.
  • Stays up to date on industry topics, trends, competitors, and best practices through research, industry events, and networking, sharing knowledge within the business segment team.
  • Collaborates with corporate shared services functions to implement the competitive strategy and achieve desired results, while aligning with corporate governance and prioritizing the customer.
  • Develops and leverages strong partnerships to drive alignment and mutual benefits for business segments and the organization.
  • Prepares and presents regular sales reports, dashboards, and visualizations to communicate sales performance, trends, and analysis to relevant stakeholders. Summarizes findings and provides actionable recommendations.
  • For field roles, only: Expected to drive/travel at least 50% of working time to perform essential functions. This may involve traveling on short notice or other daily driving duties as assigned.

Job Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in Sales, Distribution Management, or a related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales or a related field and/or commensurate work experience. 
  • For field roles, only: Valid driver’s license and a driving record that conforms to company standards.

Licenses and Certifications:

The role holder will be responsible for establishing and strengthening relationships with key focus brokers, specialist brokers, corporate in-house brokers, and selected Managing General Agents (MGAs) across the German-speaking markets. The role will drive market engagement, enhance brand presence, and contribute to profitable business growth by promoting Westfield’s underwriting capabilities, risk appetite, and specialist product offering.

The Head of Distribution, DACH will act as a trusted market representative, working closely with underwriting and leadership teams to develop sustainable distribution opportunities and support the execution within the German specialty insurance market.  

The job holder is responsible for developing and maintaining broker and market relationships and identifying business opportunities. The role does not include authority to underwrite risks, bind insurance contracts, or enter into, execute or conclude agreements on behalf of Westfield Specialty Insurance Europe S.A. (“WSIE”). Such decisions and approvals remain subject to WSIE's delegated authority and governance arrangements.

Contractual terms discussed or developed by the role holder with brokers, MGAs, clients or other third parties are, in the ordinary course, subject to further review and formal approval and execution by the Company's authorised signatories at the Company's registered office in Luxembourg, in accordance with the Company's internal signature and authority policies in force from time to time.

Key Accountabilities & Role Requirements: 

  • Develop, maintain, and strengthen strategic relationships with key brokers, clients, MGAs, and distribution partners across the German market. 

  • Identify and secure new distribution opportunities aligned with Westfield’s specialty insurance strategy and risk appetite. 

  • Promote awareness and understanding of Westfield’s underwriting capabilities, line of business, and market proposition. 

  • Support profitable growth by developing strong commercial relationships with focus brokers, specialist brokers, and corporate in-house brokers. 

  • Collaborate closely with underwriting teams to ensure alignment between market opportunities and underwriting strategy. 

  • Maintain a strong understanding of local market dynamics, the competitive landscape, broker structures, and emerging opportunities within the German-speaking insurance markets. 

  • Provide market intelligence, broker feedback, and distribution insights to internal stakeholders to support strategic decision-making. 

  • Deliver high standards of professionalism, relationship management, and stakeholder engagement while acting as an ambassador for the Westfield brand. 

  • Ensure all activities are conducted in accordance with regulatory requirements, internal governance standards, and company policies. 

  • Contribute to the successful execution of regional business plans and strategic growth initiatives.

Skills & Competencies Required:

  • Strong insurance distribution and relationship management capability within the German-speaking insurance markets. 

  • Proven ability to develop, influence, and maintain trusted long-term business relationships. 

  • Excellent commercial awareness and understanding of specialty insurance markets and distribution models. 

  • Strong networking, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. 

  • Ability to identify and convert business development opportunities into sustainable growth. 

  • Deep understanding of specialty insurance products, underwriting principles, and risk appetite frameworks. 

  • High levels of resilience, credibility, professionalism, and personal integrity. 

  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across international teams. 

  • Fluent German and English language skills are essential.  

  • Adaptability and willingness to travel within the DACH region and internationally as required.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Significant experience within the insurance industry, preferably within specialty insurance or commercial lines. 

  • Proven track record in broker management, client engagement, distribution development, or business development roles. 

  • Established network and strong market relationships within the German-speaking insurance markets would be highly advantageous. 

  • Demonstrated success in developing profitable broker and/or MGA partnerships. 

  • Strong understanding of specialty insurance products and market practices. 

  • Experience working within an international insurance environment would be beneficial. 

  • Relevant professional insurance qualifications are desirable. 

  • Degree educated or equivalent professional experience preferred.
